verses.sa:
संसं स्रवन्तु नद्यः सं वाताः सं पतत्रिणः ।
यज्ञमिमं वर्धयता गिरः संस्राव्येण हविषा जुहोमि ॥
verses.rom:
samsam sravantu nadyah sam vatah sam patatrinah |
yajnamimam vardhayata girah samsravyena havisha juhomi ||
verses.en: Together, together let the rivers flow, together the winds, together the birds; increase ye this sacrifice, O songs (gír); I make offering with an oblation of confluence.

verses.sa: इमं होमा यज्ञमवतेमं संस्रावणा उत यज्ञमिमं वर्धयता गिरः संस्राव्येण हविषा जुहोमि ॥
verses.rom: imam homa yajnamavatemam samsravana uta yajnamimam vardhayata girah samsravyena havisha juhomi ||
verses.en: This sacrifice do ye aid, O offerings (hóma); this one, ye also that flow together: increase ye this sacrifice, O songs; I make offering with an oblation of confluence.

verses.sa:
रूपंरूपं वयोवयः संरभ्यैनं परि ष्वजे ।
यज्ञमिमं चतस्रः प्रदिशो वर्धयन्तु संस्राव्येण हविषा जुहोमि ॥
verses.rom:
rupamrupam vayovayah samrabhyainam pari shvaje |
yajnamimam chatasrah pradisho vardhayantu samsravyena havisha juhomi ||
verses.en: Form by form, vigor (váyas) by vigor—taking hold together I embrace him: let the four quarters increase this sacrifice; I make offering with an oblation of confluence.

verses.sa:
शं त आपो हैमवतीः शमु ते सन्तूत्स्याः ।
शं ते सनिष्यदा आपः शमु ते सन्तु वर्ष्याः ॥
verses.rom:
sham ta apo haimavatih shamu te santutsyah |
sham te sanishyada apah shamu te santu varshyah ||
verses.en: Weal to thee [be] the waters from the snowy mountains (hāimavatá), and weal be to thee those from the fountains; weal to thee the running waters, and weal to thee be those of the rain.

verses.sa:
शं त आपो धन्वन्याः शं ते सन्त्वनूप्याः ।
शं ते खनित्रिमा आपः शं याः कुम्भेभिराभृताः ॥
verses.rom:
sham ta apo dhanvanyah sham te santvanupyah |
sham te khanitrima apah sham yah kumbhebhirabhritah ||
verses.en: Weal to thee [be] the waters of the wastes, weal be to thee those of the marshes; weal to thee the waters of the canals (khanitríma), weal those brought with vessels.

verses.sa:
अनभ्रयः खनमाना विप्रा गम्भीरे अपसः ।
भिषग्भ्यो भिषक्तरा आपो अछा वदामसि ॥
verses.rom:
anabhrayah khanamana vipra gambhire apasah |
bhishagbhyo bhishaktara apo achha vadamasi ||
verses.en: Digging for themselves without shovels, keen (vípra), working in the deep (gambhīrá), more healing than the healers (bhiṣáj), the waters we address.

verses.sa:
अपामह दिव्यानामपां स्रोतस्यानाम् ।
अपामह प्रणेजनेऽश्वा भवथ वाजिनः ॥
verses.rom:
apamaha divyanamapam srotasyanam |
apamaha pranejane'shva bhavatha vajinah ||
verses.en: Of the waters indeed from the sky, of the waters from the streams (srotasyà)—in the forth-washing indeed of the waters, ye become vigorous (vājín) horses.

verses.sa:
ता अपः शिवा अपोऽयक्ष्मंकरणीरपः ।
यथैव तृप्यते मयस्तास्त आ दत्त भेषजीः ॥
verses.rom:
ta apah shiva apo'yakshmamkaranirapah |
yathaiva tripyate mayastasta a datta bheshajih ||
verses.en: Weal [be] to thee the waters, propitious the waters, effecting freedom from yákṣma the waters; just as joy to one who thirsts, [be] they for thee healers of dislocation.

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षाद्वनस्पतिभ्यो अध्योषधीभ्यः ।
यत्रयत्र विभृतो जातवेदास्तत स्तुतो जुषमाणो न एहि ॥
verses.rom:
divasprithivyah paryantarikshadvanaspatibhyo adhyoshadhibhyah |
yatrayatra vibhrito jatavedastata stuto jushamano na ehi ||
verses.en: Forth from the sky, from the earth, from the atmosphere, out of the forest trees, the herbs—whithersoever borne, O Jātavedas, come thou, enjoying, thence to us.

verses.sa:
यस्ते अप्सु महिमा यो वनेषु य ओषधीषु पशुष्वप्स्वन्तः ।
अग्ने सर्वास्तन्वः सं रभस्व ताभिर्न एहि द्रविणोदा अजस्रः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste apsu mahima yo vaneshu ya oshadhishu pashushvapsvantah |
agne sarvastanvah sam rabhasva tabhirna ehi dravinoda ajasrah ||
verses.en: What thy greatness is in the waters, what in the woods, what in the herbs, in the cattle, within the waters—all thy bodies (tanū́), O Agni, grasp together; with them come to us, a giver of property, unfailing.

verses.sa:
यस्ते देवेषु महिमा स्वर्गो या ते तनुः पितृष्वाविवेश ।
पुष्टिर्या ते मनुष्येषु पप्रथेऽग्ने तया रयिमस्मासु धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
yaste deveshu mahima svargo ya te tanuh pitrishvavivesha |
pushtirya te manushyeshu paprathe'gne taya rayimasmasu dhehi ||
verses.en: What thy heavenly (svargá) greatness is, among the gods, what body of thine entered into the Fathers, what prosperity of thine was spread among men (manuṣyà)—therewith, O Agni, assign wealth to us.

verses.sa:
श्रुत्कर्णाय कवये वेद्याय वचोभिर्वाकैरुप यामि रातिम् ।
यतो भयमभयं तन् नो अस्त्वव देवानां यज हेडो अग्ने ॥
verses.rom:
shrutkarnaya kavaye vedyaya vachobhirvakairupa yami ratim |
yato bhayamabhayam tan no astvava devanam yaja hedo agne ||
verses.en: To him of hearing ears, the poet, worthy to be known, I apply for gifts (rātí) with words, with speeches; whence [there is] fear, be there no fear for us; pacify (ava-yaj), O Agni, the wrath (héḍas) of the gods.

verses.sa:
यामाहुतिं प्रथमामथर्वा या जाता या हव्यमकृणोज्जातवेदाः ।
तां त एतां प्रथमो जोहवीमि ताभिष्टुप्तो वहतु हव्यमग्निरग्नये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yamahutim prathamamatharva ya jata ya havyamakrinojjatavedah |
tam ta etam prathamo johavimi tabhishtupto vahatu havyamagniragnaye svaha ||
verses.en: What oblation (ā́huti) Atharvan sacrificed first, with what one Jātavedas made an offering, that same do I first call loudly for thee; gratified with that, let Agni carry the offering: hail to Agni.

verses.sa:
आकूतिं देवीं सुभगां पुरो दधे चित्तस्य माता सुहवा नो अस्तु ।
यामाशामेमि केवली सा मे अस्तु विदेयमेनां मनसि प्रविष्टाम् ॥
verses.rom:
akutim devim subhagam puro dadhe chittasya mata suhava no astu |
yamashamemi kevali sa me astu videyamenam manasi pravishtam ||
verses.en: Heavenly fortunate design (ā́kūti) do I put forward (puro-dhā); let the mother of intent (cittá) be easy of invocation for us; to what expectation I go, be it entirely mine; may I find it entered into [my] mind.

verses.sa:
आकूत्या नो बृहस्पत आकूत्या न उपा गहि ।
अथो भगस्य नो धेह्यथो नः सुहवो भव ॥
verses.rom:
akutya no brihaspata akutya na upa gahi |
atho bhagasya no dhehyatho nah suhavo bhava ||
verses.en: With design to us, O Brihaspati, with design come thou unto us; then assign to us of fortune (bhága); then be easy of invocation for us.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्म आकूतिमाङ्गिरसः प्रति जानातु वाचमेताम् ।
यस्य देवा देवताः संबभूवुः स सुप्रणीताः कामो अन्वेत्वस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatirma akutimangirasah prati janatu vachametam |
yasya deva devatah sambabhuvuh sa supranitah kamo anvetvasman ||
verses.en: Let Brihaspati acknowledge my design, the son of An̄giras this [my] speech; of whom the gods, the deities, came into being, let that desire (kā́ma), well-conducting, go after us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो राजा जगतश्चर्षणीनामधि क्षमि विषुरूपं यदस्ति ।
ततो ददाति दाशुषे वसूनि चोदद्राध उपस्तुतश्चिदर्वाक् ॥
verses.rom:
indro raja jagatashcharshaninamadhi kshami vishurupam yadasti |
tato dadati dashushe vasuni chodadradha upastutashchidarvak ||
verses.en: Indra [is] king of the moving creation (jágat), of human beings (carṣaṇí), whatever of various form is upon the earth (kṣám); thence he gives good things to his worshiper (dāçvā́ṅs); may he, whenever praised, urge (cud) hitherward bestowal (rā́dhas).

verses.sa:
सहस्रबाहुः पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्।
स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वात्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrabahuh purushah sahasrakshah sahasrapat|
sa bhumim vishvato vritvatyatishthaddashangulam ||
verses.en: Thousand-armed is Purusha, thousand-eyed, thousand-footed; he, covering the earth entirely, exceeded it by ten fingers' breadth.

verses.sa:
त्रिभिः पद्भिर्द्यामरोहत्पादस्येहाभवत्पुनः ।
तथा व्यक्रामद्विष्वङशनानशने अनु ॥
verses.rom:
tribhih padbhirdyamarohatpadasyehabhavatpunah |
tatha vyakramadvishvanashananashane anu ||
verses.en: With three feet he ascended the sky; a foot of him, again, was here; so he strode out asunder, after eating and non-eating.

verses.sa:
तावन्तो अस्य महिमानस्ततो ज्यायांश्च पूरुषः ।
पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
tavanto asya mahimanastato jyayamshcha purushah |
pado'sya vishva bhutani tripadasyamritam divi ||
verses.en: So many are his greatnesses; and Purusha is superior (jyā́jān) to that; a foot of him is all beings (bhūtá); three feet of him are what is immortal in the sky.

verses.sa:
पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भाव्यम् ।
उतामृतत्वस्येश्वरो यदन्येनाभवत्सह ॥
verses.rom:
purusha evedam sarvam yadbhutam yachcha bhavyam |
utamritatvasyeshvaro yadanyenabhavatsaha ||
verses.en: Purusha is just this all, what is and what is to be; also [is he] lord (īçvará) of immortality, which was together with another.

verses.sa:
यत्पुरुषं व्यदधुः कतिधा व्यकल्पयन् ।
मुखं किमस्य किं बाहू किमूरू पादा उच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
yatpurusham vyadadhuh katidha vyakalpayan |
mukham kimasya kim bahu kimuru pada uchyate ||
verses.en: When they separated (vi-dhā) Purusha, in how many parts did they distribute (vi-kḷp) him? what was his face? what his (two) arms? what are called his (two) thighs [and] feet?

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीद्बाहू राजन्योऽभवत्।
मध्यं तदस्य यद्वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत ॥
verses.rom:
brahmano'sya mukhamasidbahu rajanyo'bhavat|
madhyam tadasya yadvaishyah padbhyam shudro ajayata ||
verses.en: The Brahman was his face; the Kshatriya (rājanyà) became his (two) arms; the Vāiçya [was] his middle; from his (two) feet was born the Çūdra.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा मनसो जातश्चक्षोः सूर्यो अजायत ।
मुखादिन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च प्राणाद्वायुरजायत ॥
verses.rom:
chandrama manaso jatashchakshoh suryo ajayata |
mukhadindrashchagnishcha pranadvayurajayata ||
verses.en: The moon [is] born from his mind; from his eye the sun was born; from his mouth both Indra and Agni; from his breath Vāyu was born.

verses.sa:
नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षं शीर्ष्णो द्यौः समवर्तत ।
पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात्तथा लोकामकल्पयन् ॥
verses.rom:
nabhya asidantariksham shirshno dyauh samavartata |
padbhyam bhumirdishah shrotrattatha lokamakalpayan ||
verses.en: From his navel was the atmosphere; from his head the sky came into being (sam-vṛt); from his (two) feet the earth, the quarters from his ear (çrótra): so shaped they the worlds.

verses.sa:
विराडग्रे समभवद्विराजो अधि पूरुषः ।
स जातो अत्यरिच्यत पश्चाद्भूमिमथो पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
viradagre samabhavadvirajo adhi purushah |
sa jato atyarichyata pashchadbhumimatho purah ||
verses.en: Virāj in the beginning came into being (sam-bhū); out of Virāj, Purusha; it, when born, exceeded the earth behind, also in front.

verses.sa:
यत्पुरुषेण हविषा देवा यज्ञमतन्वत ।
वसन्तो अस्यासीदाज्यं ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः ॥
verses.rom:
yatpurushena havisha deva yajnamatanvata |
vasanto asyasidajyam grishma idhmah sharaddhavih ||
verses.en: When, with Purusha as oblation, the gods extended the sacrifice, spring was its sacrificial butter, summer its fuel, autumn its oblation.

verses.sa:
तं यज्ञं प्रावृषा प्रौक्षन् पुरुषं जातमग्रशः ।
तेन देवा अयजन्त साध्या वसवश्च ये ॥
verses.rom:
tam yajnam pravrisha praukshan purusham jatamagrashah |
tena deva ayajanta sadhya vasavashcha ye ||
verses.en: They sprinkled with the early rain (prāvṛ́ṣ) that sacrifice, Purusha, born in the beginning; therewith the gods sacrificed, the Perfectibles (sādhyá) and they that are Vasus.

verses.sa:
तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त ये च के चोभयादतः ।
गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात्तस्माज्जाता अजावयः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadashva ajayanta ye cha ke chobhayadatah |
gavo ha jajnire tasmattasmajjata ajavayah ||
verses.en: From that were born horses, and whatever [animals] have teeth in both jaws; kine were born from that; from that [are] born goats and sheep.

verses.sa:
तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुत ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे ।
छन्दो ह जज्ञिरे तस्माद्यजुस्तस्मादजायत ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadyajnatsarvahuta richah samani jajnire |
chhando ha jajnire tasmadyajustasmadajayata ||
verses.en: From that all-sacrificing sacrifice were born the verses (ṛ́c), the chants (sā́man); meter sic! were born from that; sacrificial formula was born from that.

verses.sa:
तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुतः संभृतं पृषदाज्यम् ।
पशूंस्तांश्चक्रे वायव्यान् आरण्या ग्राम्याश्च ये ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadyajnatsarvahutah sambhritam prishadajyam |
pashumstamshchakre vayavyan aranya gramyashcha ye ||
verses.en: From that all-sacrificing sacrifice was collected the speckled butter (pṛṣadājyá); it made those cattle belonging to Vāyu—those that are of the forest and of the village.

verses.sa:
सप्तास्यासन् परिधयस्त्रिः सप्त समिधः कृताः ।
देवा यद्यज्ञं तन्वाना अबध्नन् पुरुषं पशुम् ॥
verses.rom:
saptasyasan paridhayastrih sapta samidhah kritah |
deva yadyajnam tanvana abadhnan purusham pashum ||
verses.en: Seven were made its enclosing sticks (paridhí), thrice seven its pieces of fuel, when the gods, extending the sacrifice, bound Purusha as victim.

verses.sa:
मूर्ध्नो देवस्य बृहतो अंशवः सप्त सप्ततीः ।
राज्ञः सोमस्याजायन्त जातस्य पुरुषादधि ॥
verses.rom:
murdhno devasya brihato amshavah sapta saptatih |
rajnah somasyajayanta jatasya purushadadhi ||
verses.en: Seven times seventy rays (aṅçú) were born from the head of the great god, of king Soma, when born out of Purusha.

verses.sa:
चित्राणि साकं दिवि रोचनानि सरीसृपाणि भुवने जवानि ।
तुर्मिशं सुमतिमिच्छमानो अहानि गीर्भिः सपर्यामि नाकम् ॥
verses.rom:
chitrani sakam divi rochanani sarisripani bhuvane javani |
turmisham sumatimichchhamano ahani girbhih saparyami nakam ||
verses.en: Seeking favor of the twenty-eight-fold (?) wondrous ones, shining in the sky together, ever-moving, hasting in the creation (bhúvana), I worship (sapary) with songs the days, the firmament (nā́ka).

verses.sa:
सुहवमग्ने कृत्तिका रोहिणी चास्तु भद्रं मृगशिरः शमार्द्रा ।
पुनर्वसू सूनृता चारु पुष्यो भानुराश्लेषा अयनं मघा मे ॥
verses.rom:
suhavamagne krittika rohini chastu bhadram mrigashirah shamardra |
punarvasu sunrita charu pushyo bhanurashlesha ayanam magha me ||
verses.en: Easy of invocation for me [be] the Kṛittikās and Rohiṇī; be Mṛigaçiras excellent, [and] Ārdrā healthful (çám) be the two Punarvasus pleasantness, Pushya what is agreeable, the Āçleshās light (bhānú), the Maghās progress (áyana) for me.

verses.sa:
पुण्यं पूर्वा फल्गुन्यौ चात्र हस्तश्चित्रा शिवा स्वाति सुखो मे अस्तु ।
राधे विशाखे सुहवानुराधा ज्येष्ठा सुनक्षत्रमरिष्ट मूलम् ॥
verses.rom:
punyam purva phalgunyau chatra hastashchitra shiva svati sukho me astu |
radhe vishakhe suhavanuradha jyeshtha sunakshatramarishta mulam ||
verses.en: Be the former Phalgunīs and Hasta here auspicious (púṇyam); be Chitrā propitious, and Svāti easy (sukhá) for me; be the two Viçākhās bestowal (rā́dhas), Anurādhā easy of invocation, Jyeshṭhā a good asterism, Mūla uninjured.

verses.sa:
अन्नं पूर्वा रासतां मे अषाढा ऊर्जं देव्युत्तरा आ वहन्तु ।
अभिजिन् मे रासतां पुण्यमेव श्रवणः श्रविष्ठाः कुर्वतां सुपुष्टिम् ॥
verses.rom:
annam purva rasatam me ashadha urjam devyuttara a vahantu |
abhijin me rasatam punyameva shravanah shravishthah kurvatam supushtim ||
verses.en: Let the former Ashāḍhās give me food; let the latter ones bring refreshment; let Abhijit give me what is auspicious; let Çravaṇa [and] the Çravishṭhās make good prosperity.

verses.sa:
आ मे महच्छतभिषग्वरीय आ मे द्वया प्रोष्ठपदा सुशर्म ।
आ रेवती चाश्वयुजौ भगं म आ मे रयिं भरण्य आ वहन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
a me mahachchhatabhishagvariya a me dvaya proshthapada susharma |
a revati chashvayujau bhagam ma a me rayim bharanya a vahantu ||
verses.en: Let Çatabhishaj [bring] to me what is great widely; let the double Proshṭhapadās [bring] to me good protection (suçárman); let Revatī and the two Açvayuj [bring] fortune to me; let the Bharaṇīs bring to me wealth.

verses.sa:
यानि नक्षत्राणि दिव्यन्तरिक्षे अप्सु भूमौ यानि नगेषु दिक्षु ।
प्रकल्पयंश्चन्द्रमा यान्येति सर्वाणि ममैतानि शिवानि सन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yani nakshatrani divyantarikshe apsu bhumau yani nageshu dikshu |
prakalpayamshchandrama yanyeti sarvani mamaitani shivani santu ||
verses.en: What asterisms are in the sky, in the atmosphere, in the waters, on the earth, what ones in the mountains, in the quarters, what ones the moon goes on preparing (pra-kḷp), let all those be propitious to me.

verses.sa:
अष्टाविंशानि शिवानि शग्मानि सह योगं भजन्तु मे ।
योगं प्र पद्ये क्षेमं च क्षेमं प्र पद्ये योगं च नमोऽहोरात्राभ्यामस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
ashtavimshani shivani shagmani saha yogam bhajantu me |
yogam pra padye kshemam cha kshemam pra padye yogam cha namo'horatrabhyamastu ||
verses.en: Let them of the series of twenty-eight, propitious, helpful, together allot to me acquisition (yóga); I go forward to acquisition and possession (kṣéma); I go forward to possession and acquisition; homage be to day-and-night.

verses.sa:
स्वस्तितं मे सुप्रातः सुसायं सुदिवं सुमृगं सुशकुनं मे अस्तु ।
सुहवमग्ने स्वस्त्यमर्त्यं गत्वा पुनरायाभिनन्दन् ॥
verses.rom:
svastitam me supratah susayam sudivam sumrigam sushakunam me astu |
suhavamagne svastyamartyam gatva punarayabhinandan ||
verses.en: Be it for me well at sunset (?), well in early morning, well at evening, well by day; be it for me well with beasts, well with birds; with easy invocation, O Agni, having gone with well-being to a mortal, come thou again enjoying.

verses.sa:
अनुहवं परिहवं परिवादं परिक्षवम् ।
सर्वैर्मे रिक्तकुम्भान् परा तान्त्सवितः सुव ॥
verses.rom:
anuhavam parihavam parivadam parikshavam |
sarvairme riktakumbhan para tantsavitah suva ||
verses.en: Detraction, evil gossip, reproach, sneezing about (?)—them, O Savitar, drive (suva) away for me empty-handed (?), with all.

verses.sa:
अपपापं परिक्षवं पुण्यं भक्षीमहि क्षवम् ।
शिवा ते पाप नासिकां पुण्यगश्चाभि मेहताम् ॥
verses.rom:
apapapam parikshavam punyam bhakshimahi kshavam |
shiva te papa nasikam punyagashchabhi mehatam ||
verses.en: [Drive] away evil sneezing about; may we enjoy (bhaj) propitious (púṇya) sneezing; let the evil-nosed jackal and púṇyaga urinate upon [it] for thee.

verses.sa:
इमा या ब्रह्मणस्पते विषुचीर्वात ईरते ।
सध्रीचीरिन्द्र ताः कृत्वा मह्यं शिवतमास्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
ima ya brahmanaspate vishuchirvata irate |
sadhrichirindra tah kritva mahyam shivatamaskridhi ||
verses.en: These (fem.), O Brahmaṇaspati, that go dispersing upon the wind—do thou, O Indra, making them come together, make them most propitious for me.

verses.sa: स्वस्ति नो अस्त्वभयं नो अस्तु नमोऽहोरत्राभ्यामस्तु ॥
verses.rom: svasti no astvabhayam no astu namo'horatrabhyamastu ||
verses.en: Let well-being be ours; let fearlessness be ours; homage be to day-and-night.

verses.sa:
शान्ता द्यौः शान्ता पृथिवी शान्तमिदमुर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
शान्ता उदन्वतीरापः शान्ता नः सन्त्वोषधीः ॥
verses.rom:
shanta dyauh shanta prithivi shantamidamurvantariksham |
shanta udanvatirapah shanta nah santvoshadhih ||
verses.en: Appeased (çāntá) be heaven (dyú), appeased be earth, appeased be this wide atmosphere, appeased the waters rich in moisture (udanvánt), appeased be the herbs for us.

verses.sa:
शान्तानि पूर्वरूपाणि शान्तं नो अस्तु कृताकृतम् ।
शान्तं भूतं च भव्यं च सर्वमेव शमस्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
shantani purvarupani shantam no astu kritakritam |
shantam bhutam cha bhavyam cha sarvameva shamastu nah ||
verses.en: Appeased be the foretokens, appeased for us be the-done-and-undone, appeased both what is and what is to be: be just everything weal for us.

verses.sa:
इयं या परमेष्ठिनी वाग्देवी ब्रह्मसंशिता ।
ययैव ससृजे घोरं तयैव शान्तिरस्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
iyam ya parameshthini vagdevi brahmasamshita |
yayaiva sasrije ghoram tayaiva shantirastu nah ||
verses.en: This speech that is most exalted, divine, sharpened by bráhman, by which is produced (sṛj) what is terrible—by that be there appeasement for us.

verses.sa:
इदं यत्परमेष्ठिनं मनो वां ब्रह्मसंशितम् ।
येनैव ससृजे घोरं तेनैव शान्तिरस्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
idam yatparameshthinam mano vam brahmasamshitam |
yenaiva sasrije ghoram tenaiva shantirastu nah ||
verses.en: Or (?) this mind that is most exalted, sharpened by bráhman, by which is produced what is terrible—by that be there appeasement for us.

verses.sa:
इमानि यानि पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि मनःषष्ठानि मे हृदि ब्रह्मणा संशितानि ।
यैरेव ससृजे घोरं तैरेव शान्तिरस्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
imani yani panchendriyani manahshashthani me hridi brahmana samshitani |
yaireva sasrije ghoram taireva shantirastu nah ||
verses.en: These five senses, with mind as sixth, that are in my heart, sharpened by bráhman, by which is produced what is terrible—by them be there appeasement for us.

verses.sa:
शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं विष्णुः शं प्रजापतिः ।
शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः शं नो भवत्वर्यमा ॥
verses.rom:
sham no mitrah sham varunah sham vishnuh sham prajapatih |
sham na indro brihaspatih sham no bhavatvaryama ||
verses.en: Weal for us be Mitra, weal Varuṇa, weal Vishṇu, weal Prajāpati, weal for us Indra, Bṛihaspati, weal for us be Aryaman.

verses.sa:
शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं विवस्वां छमन्तकः ।
उत्पाताः पार्थिवान्तरिक्षाः शं नो दिविचरा ग्रहाः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no mitrah sham varunah sham vivasvam chhamantakah |
utpatah parthivantarikshah sham no divichara grahah ||
verses.en: Weal for us be Mitra, weal Varuṇa, weal Vivasvant, weal the destroyer (ántaka), [weal] the portents from earth and from atmosphere, weal for us the planets (?) moving in the sky.

verses.sa:
शं नो भूमिर्वेप्यमाना शमुल्का निर्हतं च यत्।
शं गावो लोहितक्षीराः शं भूमिरव तीर्यतीः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no bhumirvepyamana shamulka nirhatam cha yat|
sham gavo lohitakshirah sham bhumirava tiryatih ||
verses.en: Weal for us be the quaking (vip) earth, and weal what is meteor-smitten; weal be the red-milked kine, weal the earth when cleaving down.

verses.sa:
नक्षत्रमुल्काभिहतं शमस्तु नः शं नोऽभिचाराः शमु सन्तु कृत्याः ।
शं नो निखाता वल्गाः शमुल्का देशोपसर्गाः शमु नो भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
nakshatramulkabhihatam shamastu nah sham no'bhicharah shamu santu krityah |
sham no nikhata valgah shamulka deshopasargah shamu no bhavantu ||
verses.en: Be the meteor-smitten asterism weal for us; weal for us the enchantments and weal be the witchcrafts; weal for us the buried spells (valagá), weal the meteors; and weal be for us the land-plagues.

verses.sa:
शं नो ग्रहाश्चान्द्रमसाः शमादित्यश्च राहुणा ।
शं नो मृत्युर्धूमकेतुः शं रुद्रास्तिग्मतेजसः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no grahashchandramasah shamadityashcha rahuna |
sham no mrityurdhumaketuh sham rudrastigmatejasah ||
verses.en: Weal for us be the planets belonging to the moon, and weal the sun (ādityá) with Rāhu; weal for us smoke-bannered death, weal the Rudras of keen brightness.

verses.sa:
शं रुद्राः शं वसवः शमादित्याः शमग्नयः ।
शं नो महर्षयो देवाः शं देवाः शं बृहस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
sham rudrah sham vasavah shamadityah shamagnayah |
sham no maharshayo devah sham devah sham brihaspatih ||
verses.en: Weal [for us be] the Rudras, weal the Vasus, weal the Ādityas, weal the fires; weal for us the divine great seers, weal the gods, weal Bṛihaspati.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म प्रजापतिर्धाता लोका वेदाः सप्तऋषयोऽग्नयः ।
तैर्मे कृतं स्वस्त्ययनमिन्द्रो मे शर्म यच्छतु ब्रह्मा मे शर्म यच्छतु ।
विश्वे मे देवाः शर्म यच्छन्तु सर्वे मे देवाः शर्म यच्छन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
brahma prajapatirdhata loka vedah saptarishayo'gnayah |
tairme kritam svastyayanamindro me sharma yachchhatu brahma me sharma yachchhatu |
vishve me devah sharma yachchhantu sarve me devah sharma yachchhantu ||
verses.en: The bráhman, Prajāpati, Dhātar, the worlds, the Vedas, the seven seers, the fires—by them happy progress (svastyáyana) is made for me: let Indra grant (yam) me refuge; let Brahmán grant me refuge; let all the gods grant me refuge; let the gods all grant me refuge.

verses.sa:
यानि कानि चिच्छान्तानि लोके सप्तऋषयो विदुः ।
सर्वाणि शं भवन्तु मे शं मे अस्त्वभयं मे अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yani kani chichchhantani loke saptarishayo viduh |
sarvani sham bhavantu me sham me astvabhayam me astu ||
verses.en: Whatsoever things that are appeased in the world the seven seers know, be they all weal for me; let weal be mine, let fearlessness be mine.

verses.sa:
पृथिवी शान्तिरन्तरिक्षं शान्तिर्द्यौः शान्तिरापः शान्तिरोषधयः शान्तिर्वनस्पतयः शान्तिर्विश्वे मे देवाः शान्तिः सर्वे मे देवाः शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिभिः ।
यदिह घोरं यदिह क्रूरं यदिह पापं तच्छान्तं तच्छिवं सर्वमेव शमस्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
prithivi shantirantariksham shantirdyauh shantirapah shantiroshadhayah shantirvanaspatayah shantirvishve me devah shantih sarve me devah shantih shantih shantih shantibhih |
yadiha ghoram yadiha kruram yadiha papam tachchhantam tachchhivam sarvameva shamastu nah ||
verses.en: [Be] earth appeasement, atmosphere appeasement, sky appeasement, waters appeasement, herbs appeasement, forest trees appeasement; [be] all the gods appeasement for me, the gods all appeasement for me,

verses.sa:
शं न इन्द्राग्नी भवतामवोभिः शं न इन्द्रावरुणा रातहव्या ।
शमिन्द्रासोमा सुविताय शं योः शं न इन्द्रापूषणा वाजसातौ ॥
verses.rom:
sham na indragni bhavatamavobhih sham na indravaruna ratahavya |
shamindrasoma suvitaya sham yoh sham na indrapushana vajasatau ||
verses.en: Weal for us be Indra-and-Agni, with their aids; weal for us Indra-and-Varuṇa, on whom offerings are bestowed; weal Indra-and-Soma, for welfare, weal [and] profit (yós); weal for us Indra-and-Pūshan in booty-winning.

verses.sa:
शं नो भगः शमु नः शंसो अस्तु शं नः पुरंधिः शमु सन्तु रायः ।
शं नः सत्यस्य सुयमस्य शंसः शं नो अर्यमा पुरुजातो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
sham no bhagah shamu nah shamso astu sham nah puramdhih shamu santu rayah |
sham nah satyasya suyamasya shamsah sham no aryama purujato astu ||
verses.en: Weal for us be Bhaga, and weal for us Çaṅsa; weal for us Purandhi, and weal be wealths; weal for us the tribute (çáṅsa) of well-ordered (suyáma) truth; weal for us be the much-born Aryaman.

verses.sa:
शं नो धाता शमु धर्ता नो अस्तु शं न उरूची भवतु स्वधाभिः ।
शं रोदसी बृहती शं नो अद्रिः शं नो देवानां सुहवानि सन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
sham no dhata shamu dharta no astu sham na uruchi bhavatu svadhabhih |
sham rodasi brihati sham no adrih sham no devanam suhavani santu ||
verses.en: Weal for us be Dhātar, and weal for us Dhartar; weal for us be the wide-spreading one (urūcī́) with her powers (? svadhā́); weal the two

verses.sa:
शं नो अग्निर्ज्योतिरनीको अस्तु शं नो मित्रावरुणावश्विना शम् ।
शं नः सुकृतां सुकृतानि सन्तु शं न इषिरो अभि वातु वातः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no agnirjyotiraniko astu sham no mitravarunavashvina sham |
sham nah sukritam sukritani santu sham na ishiro abhi vatu vatah ||
verses.en: Weal for us be Agni with front of light, weal for us Mitra-and-Varuṇa, weal the two Açvins; weal for us be the things well done of the well-doers; weal let the lively (iṣirá) wind blow upon us.

verses.sa:
शं नो द्यावापृथिवी पूर्वहूतौ शमन्तरिक्षं दृशये नो अस्तु ।
शं न ओषधीर्वनिनो भवन्तु शं नो रजसस्पतिरस्तु जिष्णुः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no dyavaprithivi purvahutau shamantariksham drishaye no astu |
sham na oshadhirvanino bhavantu sham no rajasaspatirastu jishnuh ||
verses.en: Weal for us be heaven-and-earth in our early invocation; the atmosphere be weal for us to see; weal for us be the herbs, the trees (vanín), weal for us be the conquering lord of the welkin (rájas).

verses.sa:
शं न इन्द्रो वसुभिर्देवो अस्तु शमादित्येभिर्वरुणः सुशंसः ।
शं नो रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्जलाषः शं नस्त्वष्टा ग्नाभिरिह शृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
sham na indro vasubhirdevo astu shamadityebhirvarunah sushamsah |
sham no rudro rudrebhirjalashah sham nastvashta gnabhiriha shrinotu ||
verses.en: Weal for us be god Indra with the Vasus; weal Varuṇa of excellent praise su-çáṅsa with the Ādityas; weal for us healing (jálāsa) Rudra with the Rudras; unto weal for us let Tvashṭar listen here with his spouses (gnā́).

verses.sa:
शं नः सोमो भवतु ब्रह्म शं नः शं नो ग्रावाणः शमु सन्तु यज्ञाः ।
शं नः स्वरूनां मितयो भवन्तु शं नः प्रस्वः शं वस्तु वेदिः ॥
verses.rom:
sham nah somo bhavatu brahma sham nah sham no gravanah shamu santu yajnah |
sham nah svarunam mitayo bhavantu sham nah prasvah sham vastu vedih ||
verses.en: Weal for us be soma, weal for us the bráhman; weal for us the pressing-stones, and weal be the sacrifices; weal for us be the settings of the sacrificial posts; weal for us the sprouts (prasū́), and weal be the sacrificial hearth (védi).

verses.sa:
शं नः सूर्य उरुचक्षा उदेतु शं नो भवन्तु प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ।
शं नः पर्वता ध्रुवयो भवन्तु शं नः सिन्धवः शमु सन्त्वापः ॥
verses.rom:
sham nah surya uruchaksha udetu sham no bhavantu pradishashchatasrah |
sham nah parvata dhruvayo bhavantu sham nah sindhavah shamu santvapah ||
verses.en: With weal for us let the wide-looking sun arise; weal for us be the four directions; weal for us be the firm mountains; weal for us the rivers, and weal be the waters.

verses.sa:
शं नो अदितिर्भवतु व्रतेभिः शं नो भवन्तु मरुतः स्वर्काः ।
शं नो विष्णुः शमु पूषा नो अस्तु शं नो भवित्रं शं वस्तु वायुः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no aditirbhavatu vratebhih sham no bhavantu marutah svarkah |
sham no vishnuh shamu pusha no astu sham no bhavitram sham vastu vayuh ||
verses.en: Weal for us be Aditi with her courses (vratá); weal for us be the tuneful (svarká) Maruts; weal for us Vishṇu, and weal be for us Pūshan; weal for us the place of being (? bhavítra), and weal be Vāyu.

verses.sa:
शं नो देवः सविता त्रायमाणः शं नो भवन्तूषसो विभातीः ।
शं नः पर्जन्यो भवतु प्रजाभ्यः शं नः क्षेत्रस्य पतिरस्तु शंभुः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no devah savita trayamanah sham no bhavantushaso vibhatih |
sham nah parjanyo bhavatu prajabhyah sham nah kshetrasya patirastu shambhuh ||
verses.en: Weal for us be the rescuing god Savitar; weal for us be the outshining dawns; weal for us be Parjanya for our progeny; weal for us be the wealful lord of the field (kṣétra).

verses.sa:
शं नः सत्यस्य पतयो भवन्तु शं नो अर्वन्तः शमु सन्तु गावः ।
शं न ऋभवः सुकृतः सुहस्ताः शं नो भवतु पितरो हवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
sham nah satyasya patayo bhavantu sham no arvantah shamu santu gavah |
sham na ribhavah sukritah suhastah sham no bhavatu pitaro haveshu ||
verses.en: Weal for us be the lords of truth; weal for us the coursers and weal be the kine; weal for us the Ṛibhus, well-doers, having good hands; weal for us be the Fathers at our invocations.

verses.sa:
शं नो देवा विश्वदेवा भवन्तु शं सरस्वती सह धीभिरस्तु ।
शमभिषाचः शमु रातिषाचः शं नो दिव्याः पार्थिवाः शं नो अप्याः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no deva vishvadeva bhavantu sham sarasvati saha dhibhirastu |
shamabhishachah shamu ratishachah sham no divyah parthivah sham no apyah ||
verses.en: Weal for us be the gods, the all-gods; weal be Sarasvatī with the prayers (dhī́); weal the followers (? abhiṣác) and weal the gift-following (rātiṣác); weal for us they of the sky, they of the earth, weal for us they of the waters.

verses.sa:
शं नो अज एकपाद्देवो अस्तु शमहिर्बुध्न्यः शं समुद्रः ।
शं नो अपां नपात्पेरुरस्तु शं नः पृष्णिर्भवतु देवगोपा ॥
verses.rom:
sham no aja ekapaddevo astu shamahirbudhnyah sham samudrah |
sham no apam napatperurastu sham nah prishnirbhavatu devagopa ||
verses.en: Weal for us be the divine (devá) one-footed goat (ajá ékapad), weal the bottom snake (áhi budhnyà), weal the ocean; weal for us be Peru, grandson of the waters (apā́ṁ nápāt); weal for us be the spotted one (pṛ́çni), guarded by the gods.

verses.sa:
आदित्या रुद्रा वसवो जुषन्तामिदं ब्रह्म क्रियमाणं नवीयः ।
सृण्वन्तु नो दिव्याः पार्थिवासो गोजाता उत ये यज्ञियासः ॥
verses.rom:
aditya rudra vasavo jushantamidam brahma kriyamanam naviyah |
srinvantu no divyah parthivaso gojata uta ye yajniyasah ||
verses.en: Let the Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus enjoy this very new worship (bráhman) as it is performed; let there hear us them of the sky, them of the earth, also the kine-born, who are worshipful.

verses.sa:
ये देवानामृत्विजो यज्ञियासो मनोर्यजत्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
ye devanamritvijo yajniyaso manoryajatra amrita ritajnah |
te no rasantamurugayamadya yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en: They who are the worshipful priests (ṛtvíj) of the gods, to be worshiped of man (mánu), immortal, right-knowing—let them bestow on us today wide passage (urugāyá): do ye protect us ever with blessings.

verses.sa:
तदस्तु मित्रावरुणा तदग्ने शं योरस्मभ्यमिदमस्तु शस्तम् ।
अशीमहि गाधमुत प्रतिष्ठां नमो दिवे बृहते सादनाय ॥
verses.rom:
tadastu mitravaruna tadagne sham yorasmabhyamidamastu shastam |
ashimahi gadhamuta pratishtham namo dive brihate sadanaya ||
verses.en: Be it so, O Mitra-and-Varuṇa, so, O Agni: weal [and] profit for us be this praise (çastá); may we reach sounding (gādhá) and firm standing; homage to the great sky, [our] seat.

verses.sa:
उषा अप स्वसुस्तमः सं वर्तयति वर्तनिं सुजातता ।
अया वाजं देवहितं सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
verses.rom:
usha apa svasustamah sam vartayati vartanim sujatata |
aya vajam devahitam sanema madema shatahimah suvirah ||
verses.en: The dawn, with nobleness, makes the darkness roll together [and] away on her sister's track; therewith may we win the prize (vā́ja) set by the gods; may we revel, living a hundred winters, rich in heroes.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य बाहू स्थविरौ वृषाणौ चित्रा इमा वृषभौ पारयिष्णू ।
तौ योक्षे प्रथमो योग आगते याभ्यां जितमसुराणां स्वर्यत् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya bahu sthavirau vrishanau chitra ima vrishabhau parayishnu |
tau yokshe prathamo yoga agate yabhyam jitamasuranam svaryat ||
verses.en: Indra's two arms [are] stout, virile (vṛ́ṣan), these two wondrous successful bulls; them will I first yoke when the conjuncture (yóga) arrives—they by which was conquered the heaven (svàr) that is the Asuras'.

verses.sa:
आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम् ।
संक्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतं सेना अजयत्साकमिन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
ashuh shishano vrishabho na bhimo ghanaghanah kshobhanashcharshaninam |
samkrandano'nimisha ekavirah shatam sena ajayatsakamindrah ||
verses.en: Swift, sharp, terrible like a bull, greatly smiting, disturber of men (carṣaṇí), roaring, unwinking, sole hero, Indra conquered a hundred armies together.

verses.sa:
संक्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुनायोध्येन दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना ।
तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा ॥
verses.rom:
samkrandanenanimishena jishnunayodhyena dushchyavanena dhrishnuna |
tadindrena jayata tatsahadhvam yudho nara ishuhastena vrishna ||
verses.en: With the roaring, unwinking, conquering, invincible, immovable, bold one—with Indra thus conquer, thus overpower the fighters, O men, with the arrow-armed bull (vṛ́ṣan).

verses.sa:
स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी संस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन ।
संसृष्टजित्सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्युग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता ॥
verses.rom:
sa ishuhastaih sa nishangibhirvashi samsrashta sa yudha indro ganena |
samsrishtajitsomapa bahushardhyugradhanva pratihitabhirasta ||
verses.en: He with the arrow-armed, he with the quiver-hung, [is] controller; he, Indra with his train, brings together the fighters—[he,] conquering those brought together, soma-drinker, defiant with his arms, of formidable bow, shooting with fitted [arrows].

verses.sa:
बलविज्ञायः स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान् वाजी सहमान उग्रः ।
अभिवीरो अभिषत्वा सहोजिज्जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमा तिष्ठ गोविदम् ॥
verses.rom:
balavijnayah sthavirah pravirah sahasvan vaji sahamana ugrah |
abhiviro abhishatva sahojijjaitramindra rathama tishtha govidam ||
verses.en: To be known by his strength, stout, foremost hero, powerful, vigorous (vājín), overpowering, formidable, excelling heroes, excelling warriors, conquering with power—mount, O Indra, the victorious kine-winning chariot.

verses.sa:
इमं वीरमनु हर्षध्वमुग्रमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वम् ।
ग्रामजितं गोजितं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
imam viramanu harshadhvamugramindram sakhayo anu sam rabhadhvam |
gramajitam gojitam vajrabahum jayantamajma pramrinantamojasa ||
verses.en: Be ye excited after this formidable hero; take hold, O companions, after Indra, the troop-conqueror, kine-conqueror, thunderbolt-armed, conquering in the race, slaughtering with force.

verses.sa:
अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदाय उग्रः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः ।
दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाडयोध्योऽस्माकं सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु ॥
verses.rom:
abhi gotrani sahasa gahamano'daya ugrah shatamanyurindrah |
dushchyavanah pritanashadayodhyo'smakam sena avatu pra yutsu ||
verses.en: Plunging with power into the cow-stalls, Indra, pitiless, formidable, of hundred-fold fury, immovable, overpowering fighters, invincible—let him favor our armies in the fights.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहामित्रामपबाधमानः ।
प्रभञ्जंछत्रून् प्रमृणन्न् अमित्रान् अस्माकमेध्यविता तनूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate pari diya rathena rakshohamitramapabadhamanah |
prabhanjamchhatrun pramrinann amitran asmakamedhyavita tanunam ||
verses.en: O Bṛihaspati, fly about with thy chariot, demon-slaying, forcing away our enemies; breaking up our foes, slaughtering our enemies, be thou the helper of ourselves.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र एषां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुर एतु सोमः ।
देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्तु मध्ये ॥
verses.rom:
indra esham neta brihaspatirdakshina yajnah pura etu somah |
devasenanamabhibhanjatinam jayantinam maruto yantu madhye ||
verses.en: Indra [be] their leader; let Bṛihaspati, the sacrificial gift, the sacrifice, soma, go in front; in the midst of the smashing conquering armies of the gods let the Maruts go.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञ आदित्यानां मरुतां शर्ध उग्रम् ।
महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya vrishno varunasya rajna adityanam marutam shardha ugram |
mahamanasam bhuvanachyavanam ghosho devanam jayatamudasthat ||
verses.en: Of Indra the bull (vṛ́ṣan), of king Varuṇa, of the Ādityas, of the Maruts, the spirit (çárdhas) [is] formidable; the noise of the great-minded, creation-stirring, conquering gods hath arisen.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माकं या इषवस्ता जयन्तु ।
अस्माकं वीरा उत्तरे भवन्त्वस्मान् देवासोऽवता हवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamindrah samriteshu dhvajeshvasmakam ya ishavasta jayantu |
asmakam vira uttare bhavantvasman devaso'vata haveshu ||
verses.en: Indra [is] ours when the banners meet [in conflict]; let the arrows that are ours conquer; let our heroes be superior; us, O gods, aid ye at the invocations.

verses.sa:
इदमुच्छ्रेयोऽवसानमागां शिवे मे द्यावापृथिवी अभूताम् ।
असपत्नाः प्रदिशो मे भवन्तु न वै त्वा द्विष्मो अभयं नो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
idamuchchhreyo'vasanamagam shive me dyavaprithivi abhutam |
asapatnah pradisho me bhavantu na vai tva dvishmo abhayam no astu ||
verses.en: Here have I come up to a better stop (avasā́na); heaven-and-earth have been propitious to me; let the directions be for me free from rivals; we verily hate thee not; be there fearlessness for us.

verses.sa:
यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि ।
मघवंछग्धि तव त्वं न ऊतिभिर्वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yata indra bhayamahe tato no abhayam kridhi |
maghavamchhagdhi tava tvam na utibhirvi dvisho vi mridho jahi ||
verses.en: What we fear, O Indra, make thou fearlessness for us of it; O bounteous one, help (çak) that for us by thy aids; smite away haters, away scorners.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वयमनूराधं हवामहेऽनु राध्यास्म द्विपदा चतुष्पदा ।
मा नः सेना अररुषीरुप गुर्विषूचिरिन्द्र द्रुहो वि नाशय ॥
verses.rom:
indram vayamanuradham havamahe'nu radhyasma dvipada chatushpada |
ma nah sena ararushirupa gurvishuchirindra druho vi nashaya ||
verses.en: Indra the success-giver do we invoke; may we be successful with biped, with quadruped; let not the niggardly armies come upon us; make the haters (drúh) disperse and disappear.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्त्रातोत वृत्रहा परस्फानो वरेण्यः ।
स रक्षिता चरमतः स मध्यतः स पश्चात्स पुरस्तान् नो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
indrastratota vritraha parasphano varenyah |
sa rakshita charamatah sa madhyatah sa pashchatsa purastan no astu ||
verses.en: Indra [is] rescuer and Vṛitra-slayer, our desirable far-and-wide protector (?); be he our defender at the extremities, he in the middle, he behind, he in front.

verses.sa:
उरुं नो लोकमनु नेषि विद्वान्त्स्वर्यज्ज्योतिरभयं स्वस्ति ।
उग्रा त इन्द्र स्थविरस्य बाहू उप क्षयेम शरणा बृहन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
urum no lokamanu neshi vidvantsvaryajjyotirabhayam svasti |
ugra ta indra sthavirasya bahu upa kshayema sharana brihanta ||
verses.en: Do thou, knowing, lead us toward broad space (loká), light that is heavenly (svàr), fearlessness, well-being; may we dwell under the formidable arms of thee the stout one, O Indra, [those two] great refuges.

verses.sa:
अभयं नः करत्यन्तरिक्षमभयं द्यावापृथिवी उभे इमे ।
अभयं पश्चादभयं पुरस्तादुत्तरादधरादभयं नो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
abhayam nah karatyantarikshamabhayam dyavaprithivi ubhe ime |
abhayam pashchadabhayam purastaduttaradadharadabhayam no astu ||
verses.en: May the atmosphere make for us fearlessness; fearlessness both heaven-and-earth here; fearlessness from behind, fearlessness from in front; from above, from below be there fearlessness for us.

verses.sa:
अभयं मित्रादभयममित्रादभयं ज्ञातादभयं पुरो यः ।
अभयं नक्तमभयं दिवा नः सर्वा आशा मम मित्रं भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
abhayam mitradabhayamamitradabhayam jnatadabhayam puro yah |
abhayam naktamabhayam diva nah sarva asha mama mitram bhavantu ||
verses.en: Fearlessness from friend, fearlessness from enemy, fearlessness from one known, fearlessness [from one] that is away; fearlessness for us by night, fearlessness by day; be all places my friend.

verses.sa:
असपत्नं पुरस्तात्पश्चान् नो अभयं कृतम् ।
सविता मा दक्षिणत उत्तरान् मा शचीपतिः ॥
verses.rom:
asapatnam purastatpashchan no abhayam kritam |
savita ma dakshinata uttaran ma shachipatih ||
verses.en: Freedom from rivals in front, behind us [is] fearlessness made; Savitar [protect] me on the south, the lord of Çachī me on the north.

verses.sa:
दिवो मादित्या रक्षतु भूम्या रक्षन्त्वग्नयः ।
इन्द्राग्नी रक्षतां मा पुरस्तादश्विनावभितः शर्म यच्छताम् ।
तिरश्चीन् अघ्न्या रक्षतु जातवेदा भूतकृतो मे सर्वतः सन्तु वर्म ॥
verses.rom:
divo maditya rakshatu bhumya rakshantvagnayah |
indragni rakshatam ma purastadashvinavabhitah sharma yachchhatam |
tirashchin aghnya rakshatu jataveda bhutakrito me sarvatah santu varma ||
verses.en: From the sky let the Ādityas defend me; from the earth let the fires defend; let Indra-and-Agni defend me in front; let the Açvins yield (yam) refuge round about; crosswise let the inviolable [cow], let Jātavedas, defend [me]; let the being-makers be my defense (várman) on all sides.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्मा पातु वसुभिः पुरस्तात्तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिं छ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
agnirma patu vasubhih purastattasmin krame tasmim chhraye tam puram praimi |
sa ma rakshatu sa ma gopayatu tasma atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let Agni with the Vasus protect me on the east: in him I step, in him I take refuge (çri), to that stronghold I go forward; let him defend me, let him guard me; to him I commit myself: hail!

verses.sa:
वायुर्मान्तरिक्षेणैतस्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिं छ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
vayurmantarikshenaitasya dishah patu tasmin krame tasmim chhraye tam puram praimi |
sa ma rakshatu sa ma gopayatu tasma atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let Vāyu with the atmosphere protect me from that quarter: in him I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सोमो मा रुद्रैर्दक्षिणाया दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिं छ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
somo ma rudrairdakshinaya dishah patu tasmin krame tasmim chhraye tam puram praimi |
sa ma rakshatu sa ma gopayatu tasma atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let Soma with the Rudras protect me from the southern quarter: in him I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वरुणो मादित्यैरेतस्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिं छ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
varuno madityairetasya dishah patu tasmin krame tasmim chhraye tam puram praimi |
sa ma rakshatu sa ma gopayatu tasma atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let Varuṇa with the Ādityas protect me from that quarter: in him I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सूर्यो मा द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां प्रतीच्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिं छ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
suryo ma dyavaprithivibhyam pratichya dishah patu tasmin krame tasmim chhraye tam puram praimi |
sa ma rakshatu sa ma gopayatu tasma atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let the sun with heaven-and-earth protect me from the western quarter: in him I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
आपो मौषधीमतीरेतस्या दिशः पान्तु तासु क्रमे तासु श्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
ता मा रक्षन्तु ता मा गोपायन्तु ताभ्य आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
apo maushadhimatiretasya dishah pantu tasu krame tasu shraye tam puram praimi |
ta ma rakshantu ta ma gopayantu tabhya atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let the waters with (-mant) the herbs protect me from that quarter: in them I...; let them defend...; to them I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विश्वकर्मा मा सप्तऋषिभिरुदीच्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिं छ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
vishvakarma ma saptarishibhirudichya dishah patu tasmin krame tasmim chhraye tam puram praimi |
sa ma rakshatu sa ma gopayatu tasma atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let Viçvakarman with the seven seers protect me from the northern quarter: in him I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मा मरुत्वान् एतस्या दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिं छ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
indro ma marutvan etasya dishah patu tasmin krame tasmim chhraye tam puram praimi |
sa ma rakshatu sa ma gopayatu tasma atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let Indra with (-vant) the Maruts protect me from that quarter: in him I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिर्मा प्रजननवान्त्सह प्रतिष्ठया ध्रुवाया दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिं छ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatirma prajananavantsaha pratishthaya dhruvaya dishah patu tasmin krame tasmim chhraye tam puram praimi |
sa ma rakshatu sa ma gopayatu tasma atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let Prajāpati, possessing generative powers (prajánanavant), together with firm support (pratiṣṭhā́), protect me from the fixed quarter: in him I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्मा विश्वैर्देवैरूर्ध्वाया दिशः पातु तस्मिन् क्रमे तस्मिं छ्रये तां पुरं प्रैमि ।
स मा रक्षतु स मा गोपायतु तस्मा आत्मानं परि ददे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatirma vishvairdevairurdhvaya dishah patu tasmin krame tasmim chhraye tam puram praimi |
sa ma rakshatu sa ma gopayatu tasma atmanam pari dade svaha ||
verses.en: Let Bṛihaspati with all the gods protect me from the upward quarter: in him I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अग्निं ते वसुवन्तमृच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायवः प्राच्या दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim te vasuvantamrichchhantu |
ye maghayavah prachya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants (aghāyú) who shall attack (abhi-dās) me from the eastern quarter come upon (ṛch) Agni with (-vant) the Vasus.

verses.sa:
वायुं तेऽन्तरिक्षवन्तमृच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायव एतस्या दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
vayum te'ntarikshavantamrichchhantu |
ye maghayava etasya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants who shall attack me from that quarter come upon Vāyu with the atmosphere.

verses.sa:
सोमं ते रुद्रवन्तमृच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायवो दक्षिणाया दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
somam te rudravantamrichchhantu |
ye maghayavo dakshinaya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants who shall attack me from the southern quarter come upon Soma with the Rudras.

verses.sa:
वरुणं त आदित्यवन्तमृच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायव एतस्या दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
varunam ta adityavantamrichchhantu |
ye maghayava etasya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants who shall attack me from that quarter come upon Varuṇa with the Ādityas.

verses.sa:
सूर्यं ते द्यावापृथिवीवन्तमृच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायव प्रतीच्या दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
suryam te dyavaprithivivantamrichchhantu |
ye maghayava pratichya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants who shall attack me from the western quarter come upon the sun with heaven-and-earth.

verses.sa:
अपस्त ओषधीमतीर्ऋच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायव एतस्या दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
apasta oshadhimatirrichchhantu |
ye maghayava etasya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants who shall attack me from that quarter come upon the waters with the herbs.

verses.sa:
विश्वकर्माणं ते सप्तऋषिवन्तमृच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायव उदीच्या दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvakarmanam te saptarishivantamrichchhantu |
ye maghayava udichya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants who shall attack me from the northern quarter come upon Viçvakarman with the seven seers.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं ते मरुत्वन्तमृच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायव एतस्या दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
indram te marutvantamrichchhantu |
ye maghayava etasya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants who shall attack me from that quarter come upon Indra with the Maruts.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिं ते प्रजननवन्तमृच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायवो ध्रुवाया दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatim te prajananavantamrichchhantu |
ye maghayavo dhruvaya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants who shall attack me from the fixed quarter come upon Prajāpati with generative qualities.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिं ते विश्वदेववन्तमृच्छन्तु ।
ये माघायव ऊर्ध्वाया दिशोऽभिदासान् ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatim te vishvadevavantamrichchhantu |
ye maghayava urdhvaya disho'bhidasan ||
verses.en: Let those malignants who shall attack me from the upward quarter come upon Bṛihaspati with all the gods.

verses.sa:
मित्रः पृथिव्योदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
mitrah prithivyodakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: Mitra ascended with the earth: to that stronghold I lead you forward; that enter ye into; that enter ye; let that yield (yam) you both refuge and defense.

verses.sa:
वायुरन्तरिक्षेणोदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
vayurantarikshenodakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: Vāyu ascended with the atmosphere: to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सूर्यो दिवोदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
suryo divodakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: The sun ascended with the sky: to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा नक्षत्रैरुदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
chandrama nakshatrairudakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: The moon ascended with the asterisms: to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सोम ओषधीभिरुदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
soma oshadhibhirudakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: Soma ascended with the herbs: to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यज्ञो दक्षिणाभिरुदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
yajno dakshinabhirudakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: The sacrifice ascended with the sacrificial gifts: to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
समुद्रो नदीभिरुदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
samudro nadibhirudakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: The ocean ascended with the streams: to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म ब्रह्मचारिभिरुदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
brahma brahmacharibhirudakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: The bráhman ascended with the Vedic students: to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वीर्येणोदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
indro viryenodakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: Indra ascended with heroism: to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
देवा अमृतेनोदक्रामंस्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
deva amritenodakramamstam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: The gods ascended with the immortal (amṛ́ta): to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिः प्रजाभिरुदक्रामत्तां पुरं प्र णयामि वः ।
तामा विशत तां प्र विशत सा वः शर्म च वर्म च यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatih prajabhirudakramattam puram pra nayami vah |
tama vishata tam pra vishata sa vah sharma cha varma cha yachchhatu ||
verses.en: Prajāpati ascended with progeny: to that stronghold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अप न्यधुः पौरुषेयं वधं यमिन्द्राग्नी धाता सविता बृहस्पतिः ।
सोमो राजा वरुणो अश्विना यमः पूषास्मान् परि पातु मृत्योः ॥
verses.rom:
apa nyadhuh paurusheyam vadham yamindragni dhata savita brihaspatih |
somo raja varuno ashvina yamah pushasman pari patu mrityoh ||
verses.en: Have set down apart the human deadly weapon Indra-and-Agni, Dhātar, Savitar, Bṛihaspati, king Soma, Varuṇa, the Açvins, Yama; let Pūshan protect us round about from death.

verses.sa:
यानि चकार भुवनस्य यस्पतिः प्रजापतिर्मातरिश्वा प्रजाभ्यः ।
प्रदिशो यानि वसते दिशश्च तानि मे वर्माणि बहुलानि सन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yani chakara bhuvanasya yaspatih prajapatirmatarishva prajabhyah |
pradisho yani vasate dishashcha tani me varmani bahulani santu ||
verses.en: What [defenses] he who is lord of creation, Prajāpati, Mātariçvan, made for his creatures (prajā́), what ones the directions and the quarters put on (vas)—let those defenses (várman) be abundant (bahulá) for me.

verses.sa:
यत्ते तनूष्वनह्यन्त देवा द्युराजयो देहिनः ।
इन्द्रो यच्चक्रे वर्म तदस्मान् पातु विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
yatte tanushvanahyanta deva dyurajayo dehinah |
indro yachchakre varma tadasman patu vishvatah ||
verses.en: What [defense] those gods fastened on themselves, when fighting for overlordship, what defense Indra made for himself, let that protect us on all sides.

verses.sa:
वर्म मे द्यावापृथिवी वर्माहर्वर्म सूर्यः ।
वर्म मे विश्वे देवाः क्रन् मा मा प्रापत्प्रतीचिका ॥
verses.rom:
varma me dyavaprithivi varmaharvarma suryah |
varma me vishve devah kran ma ma prapatpratichika ||
verses.en: Defense for me may heaven-and-earth, defense may day, defense may the sun, defense for me may all the gods make; let not the affrontress (? pratīcikā́) reach me.

verses.sa: गायत्र्युष्णिगनुष्टुब्बृहती पङ्क्तिस्त्रिष्टुब्जगत्यै ॥
verses.rom: gayatryushniganushtubbrihati panktistrishtubjagatyai ||
verses.en: Gāyatrī, uṣṇih, anuṣṭubh, bṛhatī, pan̄kti, triṣṭubh-and-jagatī.

verses.sa: आङ्गिरसानामाद्यैः पञ्चानुवाकैः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: angirasanamadyaih panchanuvakaih svaha ||
verses.en: With the first five anuvākás of the Ān̄girasas, hail!

verses.sa: षष्ठाय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: shashthaya svaha ||
verses.en: To the sixth, hail!

verses.sa: सप्तमाष्टमाभ्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: saptamashtamabhyam svaha ||
verses.en: To the seventh-and-eighth, hail!

verses.sa: नीलनखेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: nilanakhebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the black claws, hail!

verses.sa: हरितेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: haritebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the green ones, hail!

verses.sa: क्षुद्रेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: kshudrebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the petty ones, hail!

verses.sa: पर्यायिकेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: paryayikebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of the paryāyas, hail!

verses.sa: प्रथमेभ्यः शङ्खेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: prathamebhyah shankhebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the first conchs, hail!

verses.sa: द्वितीयेभ्यः शङ्खेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: dvitiyebhyah shankhebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the second conchs, hail!

verses.sa: तृतीयेभ्यः शङ्खेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: tritiyebhyah shankhebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the third conchs, hail!

verses.sa: उपोत्तमेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: upottamebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the next to the last ones, hail!

verses.sa: उत्तमेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: uttamebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the last ones, hail!

verses.sa: उत्तरेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: uttarebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the further ones, hail!

verses.sa: ऋषिभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: rishibhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the seers, hail!

verses.sa: शिखिभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: shikhibhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the peaked ones (? çikhín), hail!

verses.sa: गणेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: ganebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the gaṇás, hail!

verses.sa: महागणेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: mahaganebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the great gaṇás, hail!

verses.sa: सर्वेभ्योऽङ्गिरोभ्यो विदगणेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: sarvebhyo'ngirobhyo vidaganebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To all the gaṇá-knowing (??) An̄girases, hail!

verses.sa: पृथक्सहस्राभ्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: prithaksahasrabhyam svaha ||
verses.en: To the two thousands severally, hail!

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: brahmane svaha ||
verses.en: To the bráhman (?), hail!

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मज्येष्ठा सम्भृता विर्याणि ब्रह्माग्रे ज्येष्ठं दिवमा ततान ।
भूतानां ब्रह्मा प्रथमोत जज्ञे तेनार्हति ब्रह्मणा स्पर्धितुं कः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmajyeshtha sambhrita viryani brahmagre jyeshtham divama tatana |
bhutanam brahma prathamota jajne tenarhati brahmana spardhitum kah ||
verses.en: Heroisms [were] gathered with the bráhman as chief; the bráhman as chief in the beginning stretched the sky; the Brahman was born as first of creatures; therefore (téna) who is fit to contend with the Brahman?

verses.sa: आथर्वणानां चतुर्ऋचेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: atharvananam chaturrichebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of four verses of the Ātharvaṇas, hail!

verses.sa: पञ्चर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: pancharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of five verses, hail!

verses.sa: षळृचेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: shalrichebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of six verses, hail!

verses.sa: सप्तर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: saptarchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of seven verses, hail!

verses.sa: अष्टर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: ashtarchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of eight verses, hail!

verses.sa: नवर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: navarchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of nine verses, hail!

verses.sa: दशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: dasharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of ten verses, hail!

verses.sa: एकादशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: ekadasharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of eleven verses, hail!

verses.sa: द्वादशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: dvadasharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of twelve verses, hail!

verses.sa: त्रयोदशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: trayodasharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of thirteen verses, hail!

verses.sa: चतुर्दशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: chaturdasharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of fourteen verses, hail!

verses.sa: पञ्चदशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: panchadasharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of fifteen verses, hail!

verses.sa: षोडशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: shodasharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of sixteen verses, hail!

verses.sa: सप्तदशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: saptadasharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of seventeen verses, hail!

verses.sa: अष्टादशर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: ashtadasharchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of eighteen verses, hail!

verses.sa: एकोनविंशतिः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: ekonavimshatih svaha ||
verses.en: Nineteen: hail!

verses.sa: विंशतिः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: vimshatih svaha ||
verses.en: Twenty: hail!

verses.sa: महत्काण्डाय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: mahatkandaya svaha ||
verses.en: To the great book (mahat-kāṇḍá), hail!

verses.sa: तृचेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: trichebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of three verses, hail!

verses.sa: एकर्चेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: ekarchebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of one verse, hail!

verses.sa: क्षुद्रेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: kshudrebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the petty ones, hail!

verses.sa: एकानृचेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: ekanrichebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of a half-verse, hail!

verses.sa: रोहितेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: rohitebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To the ruddy ones (rohita), hail!

verses.sa: सूर्याभ्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: suryabhyam svaha ||
verses.en: To the two Sūryās, hail!

verses.sa: व्रात्याभ्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: vratyabhyam svaha ||
verses.en: To the two Vrātyas, hail!

verses.sa: प्राजापत्याभ्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: prajapatyabhyam svaha ||
verses.en: To the two of Prajāpati, hail!

verses.sa: विषासह्यै स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: vishasahyai svaha ||
verses.en: To the viṣāsahí, hail!

verses.sa: मङ्गलिकेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: mangalikebhyah svaha ||
verses.en: To them of good omen (man̄galiká), hail!

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: brahmane svaha ||
verses.en: To the bráhman, hail!

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मज्येष्ठा संभृता वीर्याणि ब्रह्माग्रे ज्येष्ठं दिवमा ततान ।
भूतानां ब्रह्मा प्रथमोत जज्ञे तेनार्हति ब्रह्मणा स्पर्धितुं कः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmajyeshtha sambhrita viryani brahmagre jyeshtham divama tatana |
bhutanam brahma prathamota jajne tenarhati brahmana spardhitum kah ||
verses.en: Heroisms were gathered with the bráhman as chief; the bráhman as chief in the beginning stretched the sky; the Brahmán was born as first of creatures; therefore who is fit to contend with the Brahmán?

verses.sa:
येन देवं सवितारं परि देवा अधारयन् ।
तेनेमं ब्रह्मणस्पते परि राष्ट्राय धत्तन ॥
verses.rom:
yena devam savitaram pari deva adharayan |
tenemam brahmanaspate pari rashtraya dhattana ||
verses.en: With what [garment] the gods caused to wrap god Savitar, with that, O Brahmaṇaspati, do ye wrap this man in order to royalty.

verses.sa:
परीममिन्द्रमायुषे महे क्षत्राय धत्तन ।
यथैनं जरसे नयाज्ज्योक्क्षत्रेऽधि जागरत् ॥
verses.rom:
parimamindramayushe mahe kshatraya dhattana |
yathainam jarase nayajjyokkshatre'dhi jagarat ||
verses.en: Wrap ye this man [as] Indra in order to life-time, to great dominion, that [it] may conduct him unto old age; may he long watch over dominion.

verses.sa:
परीममिन्द्रमायुषे महे श्रोत्राय धत्तन ।
यथैनं जरसे नयाज्ज्योक्श्रोत्रेऽधि जागरत् ॥
verses.rom:
parimamindramayushe mahe shrotraya dhattana |
yathainam jarase nayajjyokshrotre'dhi jagarat ||
verses.en: Wrap ye this man [as] Soma in order to life-time, to great instruction (çrótra), that [it] may conduct him unto old age; may he long watch over instruction.

verses.sa:
परि धत्त धत्त नो वर्चसेमं जरामृत्युं कृणुत दीर्घमायुः ।
बृहस्पतिः प्रायच्छद्वास एतत्सोमाय राज्ञे परिधातवा उ ॥
verses.rom:
pari dhatta dhatta no varchasemam jaramrityum krinuta dirghamayuh |
brihaspatih prayachchhadvasa etatsomaya rajne paridhatava u ||
verses.en: Wrap, set ye him for us with splendor; make him one to die of old age; [make] long life-time; Bṛihaspati furnished (pra-yam) this garment to king Soma for wrapping himself.

verses.sa:
जरां सु गच्छ परि धत्स्व वासो भवा गृष्टीनामभिशस्तिपा उ ।
शतं च जीव शरदः पुरूची रायश्च पोषमुपसंव्ययस्व ॥
verses.rom:
jaram su gachchha pari dhatsva vaso bhava grishtinamabhishastipa u |
shatam cha jiva sharadah puruchi rayashcha poshamupasamvyayasva ||
verses.en: Go thou safely (sú) unto old age; wrap thyself in the garment; become thou protector of the people (?) against imprecation; and live thou a hundred numerous autumns; and wrap further about (upa-sam-vyā) thee abundance of wealth.

verses.sa:
परीदं वासो अधिथाः स्वस्तयेऽभूर्वापीनामभिशस्तिपा उ ।
शतं च जीव शरदः पुरूचीर्वसूनि चारुर्वि भजासि जीवन् ॥
verses.rom:
paridam vaso adhithah svastaye'bhurvapinamabhishastipa u |
shatam cha jiva sharadah puruchirvasuni charurvi bhajasi jivan ||
verses.en: Thou hast wrapped thyself in this garment in order to well-being; thou hast become protector of thine allies (?) against imprecation; and live thou a hundred numerous autumns; living, pleasant (cā́ru), thou shalt share out good things.

verses.sa:
योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे ।
सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
yogeyoge tavastaram vajevaje havamahe |
sakhaya indramutaye ||
verses.en: We, companions, call to aid Indra the very mighty at every conjuncture, in every contest (? vā́ja).

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णो अजरः सुवीरो जरामृत्युः प्रजया सं विशस्व ।
तदग्निराह तदु सोम आह बृहस्पतिः सविता तदिन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyavarno ajarah suviro jaramrityuh prajaya sam vishasva |
tadagniraha tadu soma aha brihaspatih savita tadindrah ||
verses.en: Of golden color, unaging, of excellent heroes, having old age as death, do thou enter into union (sam-viç) with progeny: this Agni says, and this Soma says, this Bṛihaspati, Savitar, Indra.

verses.sa:
अश्रान्तस्य त्वा मनसा युनज्मि प्रथमस्य च ।
उत्कूलमुद्वहो भवोदुह्य प्रति धावतात् ॥
verses.rom:
ashrantasya tva manasa yunajmi prathamasya cha |
utkulamudvaho bhavoduhya prati dhavatat ||

prose.en:
7. We, companions, call to aid Indra the very mighty at every conjuncture, in every contest (? vā́ja).

8. Of golden color, unaging, of excellent heroes, having old age as death, do thou enter into union (sam-viç) with progeny: this Agni says, and this Soma says, this Bṛihaspati, Savitar, Indra.

verses.sa:
अग्नेः प्रजातं परि यद्धिरण्यममृतं दध्रे अधि मर्त्येषु ।
य एनद्वेद स इदेनमर्हति जरामृत्युर्भवति यो बिभर्ति ॥
verses.rom:
agneh prajatam pari yaddhiranyamamritam dadhre adhi martyeshu |
ya enadveda sa idenamarhati jaramrityurbhavati yo bibharti ||
verses.en: The gold that, born out of the fire, immortal, maintains itself over mortals—whoso knows it, he verily merits (arh) it; one that dies of old age becomes he who wears (bhṛ) it.

verses.sa:
यद्धिरण्यं सूर्येण सुवर्णं प्रजावन्तो मनवः पूर्व ईषिरे ।
तत्त्वा चन्द्रं वर्चसा सं सृजत्यायुष्मान् भवति यो बिभर्ति ॥
verses.rom:
yaddhiranyam suryena suvarnam prajavanto manavah purva ishire |
tattva chandram varchasa sam srijatyayushman bhavati yo bibharti ||
verses.en: The gold, of beauteous color by the sun, that men (mánu) of old with their progeny sought—that, shining (candrá), shall unite thee with splendor; of long life becomes he who wears it.

verses.sa:
आयुषे त्वा वर्चसे त्वौजसे च बलाय च ।
यथा हिरण्यतेजसा विभासासि जनामनु ॥
verses.rom:
ayushe tva varchase tvaujase cha balaya cha |
yatha hiranyatejasa vibhasasi janamanu ||
verses.en: For life-time thee, for splendor thee, and for force and for strength—that with brilliancy of gold thou mayest shine out among the people.

verses.sa:
यद्वेद राजा वरुणो वेद देवो बृहस्पतिः ।
इन्द्रो यद्वृत्रहा वेद तत्त आयुष्यं भुवत्तत्ते वर्चस्यं भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
yadveda raja varuno veda devo brihaspatih |
indro yadvritraha veda tatta ayushyam bhuvattatte varchasyam bhuvat ||
verses.en: What king Varuṇa knows, [what] divine Bṛihaspati knows, what Indra the Vṛitra-slayer knows,—may that be for thee life-giving, may that be for thee splendor-giving.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्ट्वा पात्वृषभो वृषा त्वा पातु वाजिभिः ।
वायुष्ट्वा ब्रह्मणा पात्विन्द्रस्त्वा पात्विन्द्रियैः ॥
verses.rom:
gobhishtva patvrishabho vrisha tva patu vajibhih |
vayushtva brahmana patvindrastva patvindriyaih ||

verses.sa:
सोमस्त्वा पात्वोषधीभिर्नक्षत्रैः पातु सूर्यः ।
माद्भ्यस्त्वा चन्द्रो वृत्रहा वातः प्राणेन रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
somastva patvoshadhibhirnakshatraih patu suryah |
madbhyastva chandro vritraha vatah pranena rakshatu ||

verses.sa:
तिस्रो दिवस्तिस्रः पृथिवीस्त्रीण्यन्तरिक्षाणि चतुरः समुद्रान् ।
त्रिवृतं स्तोमं त्रिवृत आप आहुस्तास्त्वा रक्षन्तु त्रिवृता त्रिवृद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
tisro divastisrah prithivistrinyantarikshani chaturah samudran |
trivritam stomam trivrita apa ahustastva rakshantu trivrita trivridbhih ||

verses.sa:
त्रीन् नाकांस्त्रीन् समुद्रांस्त्रीन् ब्रध्नांस्त्रीन् वैष्टपान् ।
त्रीन् मातरिश्वनस्त्रीन्त्सूर्यान् गोप्तॄन् कल्पयामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
trin nakamstrin samudramstrin bradhnamstrin vaishtapan |
trin matarishvanastrintsuryan goptrin kalpayami te ||

verses.sa:
घृतेन त्वा समुक्षाम्यग्ने आज्येन वर्धयन् ।
अग्नेश्चन्द्रस्य सूर्यस्य मा प्राणं मायिनो दभन् ॥
verses.rom:
ghritena tva samukshamyagne ajyena vardhayan |
agneshchandrasya suryasya ma pranam mayino dabhan ||

verses.sa:
मा वः प्राणं मा वोऽपानं मा हरो मायिनो दभन् ।
भ्राजन्तो विश्ववेदसो देवा दैव्येन धावत ॥
verses.rom:
ma vah pranam ma vo'panam ma haro mayino dabhan |
bhrajanto vishvavedaso deva daivyena dhavata ||

verses.sa:
प्राणेनाग्निं सं सृजति वातः प्राणेन संहितः ।
प्राणेन विश्वतोमुखं सूर्यं देवा अजनयन् ॥
verses.rom:
pranenagnim sam srijati vatah pranena samhitah |
pranena vishvatomukham suryam deva ajanayan ||

verses.sa:
आयुषायुःकृतां जीवायुष्मान् जीव मा मृथाः ।
प्राणेनात्मन्वतां जीव मा मृत्योरुदगा वशम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayushayuhkritam jivayushman jiva ma mrithah |
pranenatmanvatam jiva ma mrityorudaga vasham ||

verses.sa:
देवानां निहितं निधिं यमिन्द्रोऽन्वविन्दत्पथिभिर्देवयानैः ।
आपो हिरण्यं जुगुपुस्त्रिवृद्भिस्तास्त्वा रक्षन्तु त्रिवृता त्रिवृद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
devanam nihitam nidhim yamindro'nvavindatpathibhirdevayanaih |
apo hiranyam jugupustrivridbhistastva rakshantu trivrita trivridbhih ||

verses.sa:
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवतास्त्रीणि च वीर्याणि प्रियायमाणा जुगुपुरप्स्वन्तः ।
अस्मिंश्चन्द्रे अधि यद्धिरण्यं तेनायं कृणवद्वीर्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
trayastrimshaddevatastrini cha viryani priyayamana jugupurapsvantah |
asmimshchandre adhi yaddhiranyam tenayam krinavadviryani ||

verses.sa: ये देवा दिव्येकादश स्थ ते देवासो हविरिदं जुषध्वम् ॥
verses.rom: ye deva divyekadasha stha te devaso haviridam jushadhvam ||

verses.sa: ये देवा अन्तरिक्ष एकादश स्थ ते देवासो हविरिदं जुषध्वम् ॥
verses.rom: ye deva antariksha ekadasha stha te devaso haviridam jushadhvam ||

verses.sa: ये देवा पृथिव्यामेकादश स्थ ते देवासो हविरिदं जुषध्वम् ॥
verses.rom: ye deva prithivyamekadasha stha te devaso haviridam jushadhvam ||

verses.sa:
असपत्नं पुरस्तात्पश्चान् नो अभयं कृतम् ।
सविता मा दक्षिणत उत्तरान् मा शचीपतिः ॥
verses.rom:
asapatnam purastatpashchan no abhayam kritam |
savita ma dakshinata uttaran ma shachipatih ||

verses.sa:
दिवो मादित्या रक्षन्तु भूम्या रक्षन्त्वग्नयः ।
इन्द्राग्नी रक्षतां मा पुरस्तादश्विनावभितः शर्म यच्छताम् ।
तिरश्चीन् अघ्न्या रक्षतु जातवेदा भूतकृतो मे सर्वतः सन्तु वर्म ॥
verses.rom:
divo maditya rakshantu bhumya rakshantvagnayah |
indragni rakshatam ma purastadashvinavabhitah sharma yachchhatam |
tirashchin aghnya rakshatu jataveda bhutakrito me sarvatah santu varma ||

verses.sa:
इमं बध्नामि ते मणिं दीर्घायुत्वाय तेजसे ।
दर्भं सपत्नदम्भनं द्विषतस्तपनं हृदः ॥
verses.rom:
imam badhnami te manim dirghayutvaya tejase |
darbham sapatnadambhanam dvishatastapanam hridah ||
verses.en: I bind for thee this amulet, in order to long life, to brilliancy—the darbhá, damager of rivals, burner (tápana) of the heart of the hater.

verses.sa:
द्विषतस्तापयन् हृदः शत्रूणां तापयन् मनः ।
दुर्हार्दः सर्वांस्त्वं दर्भ घर्म इवाभीन्त्संतापयन् ॥
verses.rom:
dvishatastapayan hridah shatrunam tapayan manah |
durhardah sarvamstvam darbha gharma ivabhintsamtapayan ||
verses.en: Burner of the heart of the hater, causing to burn the mind of foes, do thou, O darbhá, burn together like heat (gharmá) against all the evil-hearted.

verses.sa:
घर्म इवाभितपन् दर्भ द्विषतो नितपन् मणे ।
हृदः सपत्नानां भिन्द्धीन्द्र इव विरुजं बलम् ॥
verses.rom:
gharma ivabhitapan darbha dvishato nitapan mane |
hridah sapatnanam bhinddhindra iva virujam balam ||
verses.en: Burning against [them] like heat, O darbhá, burning down the haters, O amulet, split thou our rivals to the heart, like Indra breaking apart Vala.

verses.sa:
भिन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नानां हृदयं द्विषतां मणे ।
उद्यन् त्वचमिव भूम्याः शिर एषां वि पातय ॥
verses.rom:
bhinddhi darbha sapatnanam hridayam dvishatam mane |
udyan tvachamiva bhumyah shira esham vi pataya ||
verses.en: Split, O darbhá, the heart of our rivals, of our haters, O amulet; make their head fly apart, as the rising [sun] does the skin of the earth.

verses.sa:
भिन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे भिन्द्धि मे पृतनायतः ।
भिन्द्धि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो भिन्द्धि मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
bhinddhi darbha sapatnan me bhinddhi me pritanayatah |
bhinddhi me sarvan durhardo bhinddhi me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Split, O darbhá, my rivals; split those that fight against me; split all my enemies (durhā́rd); split my haters, O amulet.

verses.sa:
छिन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे छिन्द्धि मे पृतनायतः ।
छिन्द्धि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो छिन्द्धि मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
chhinddhi darbha sapatnan me chhinddhi me pritanayatah |
chhinddhi me sarvan durhardo chhinddhi me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Sever, O darbhá, my rivals; sever those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वृश्च दर्भ सपत्नान् मे वृश्च मे पृतनायतः ।
वृश्च मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो वृश्च मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
vrishcha darbha sapatnan me vrishcha me pritanayatah |
vrishcha me sarvan durhardo vrishcha me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Hew down (vraçc), O darbhá, my rivals; hew down those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
कृन्त दर्भ सपत्नान् मे कृन्त मे पृतनायतः ।
कृन्त मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो कृन्त मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
krinta darbha sapatnan me krinta me pritanayatah |
krinta me sarvan durhardo krinta me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Cut, O darbhá, my rivals; cut those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
पिंश दर्भ सपत्नान् मे पिंश मे पृतनायतः ।
पिंश मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो पिंश मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
pimsha darbha sapatnan me pimsha me pritanayatah |
pimsha me sarvan durhardo pimsha me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Carve (?), O darbhá, my rivals; carve those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विध्य दर्भ सपत्नान् मे विध्य मे पृतनायतः ।
विध्य मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो विध्य मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
vidhya darbha sapatnan me vidhya me pritanayatah |
vidhya me sarvan durhardo vidhya me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Pierce, O darbhá, my rivals; pierce those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
निक्ष दर्भ सपत्नान् मे निक्ष मे पृतनायतः ।
निक्ष मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो निक्ष मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
niksha darbha sapatnan me niksha me pritanayatah |
niksha me sarvan durhardo niksha me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Gore, O darbhá, my rivals; gore those that fight against me; gore all my enemies; gore my haters, O amulet.

verses.sa:
तृन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे तृन्द्धि मे पृतनायतः ।
तृन्द्धि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो तृन्द्धि मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
trinddhi darbha sapatnan me trinddhi me pritanayatah |
trinddhi me sarvan durhardo trinddhi me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Bore, O darbhá, my rivals; bore those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
रुन्द्धि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे रुन्द्धि मे पृतनायतः ।
रुन्द्धि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो रुन्द्धि मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
runddhi darbha sapatnan me runddhi me pritanayatah |
runddhi me sarvan durhardo runddhi me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Obstruct, O darbhá, my rivals; obstruct those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
मृण दर्भ सपत्नान् मे मृण मे पृतनायतः ।
मृण मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो मृण मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
mrina darbha sapatnan me mrina me pritanayatah |
mrina me sarvan durhardo mrina me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Kill, O darbhá, my rivals; kill those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
मन्थ दर्भ सपत्नान् मे मन्थ मे पृतनायतः ।
मन्थ मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो मन्थ मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
mantha darbha sapatnan me mantha me pritanayatah |
mantha me sarvan durhardo mantha me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Grind, O darbhá, my rivals; grind those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
पिण्ड्ढि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे पिण्ड्ढि मे पृतनायतः ।
पिण्ड्ढि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो पिण्ड्ढि मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
pinddhi darbha sapatnan me pinddhi me pritanayatah |
pinddhi me sarvan durhardo pinddhi me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Crush (piṣ), O darbhá, my rivals; crush those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ओष दर्भ सपत्नान् मे ओष मे पृतनायतः ।
ओष मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो ओष मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
osha darbha sapatnan me osha me pritanayatah |
osha me sarvan durhardo osha me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Scorch (uṣ), O darbhá, my rivals; scorch those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
दह दर्भ सपत्नान् मे दह मे पृतनायतः ।
दह मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो दह मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
daha darbha sapatnan me daha me pritanayatah |
daha me sarvan durhardo daha me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Burn, O darbhá, my rivals; burn those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
जहि दर्भ सपत्नान् मे जहि मे पृतनायतः ।
जहि मे सर्वान् दुर्हार्दो जहि मे द्विषतो मणे ॥
verses.rom:
jahi darbha sapatnan me jahi me pritanayatah |
jahi me sarvan durhardo jahi me dvishato mane ||
verses.en: Slay, O darbhá, my rivals; slay those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यत्ते दर्भ जरामृत्यु शतं वर्मसु वर्म ते ।
तेनेमं वर्मिणं कृत्वा सपत्नां जहि वीर्यैः ॥
verses.rom:
yatte darbha jaramrityu shatam varmasu varma te |
tenemam varminam kritva sapatnam jahi viryaih ||
verses.en: What thou hast that brings death in old age, O darbhá, that has hundred-fold defense, good defense, therewith having made this man defended (varmín), smite thou my rivals by thy heroisms.

verses.sa:
शतं ते दर्भ वर्माणि सहस्रं वीर्याणि ते ।
तमस्मै विश्वे त्वां देवा जरसे भर्तवा अदुः ॥
verses.rom:
shatam te darbha varmani sahasram viryani te |
tamasmai vishve tvam deva jarase bhartava aduh ||
verses.en: A hundred are thy defenses, O darbhá, a thousand thy heroisms; as such, all the gods have given thee to this man to wear, in order to [attain] old age.

verses.sa:
त्वामाहुर्देववर्म त्वां दर्भ ब्रह्मणस्पतिम् ।
त्वामिन्द्रस्याहुर्वर्म त्वं राष्ट्राणि रक्षसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamahurdevavarma tvam darbha brahmanaspatim |
tvamindrasyahurvarma tvam rashtrani rakshasi ||
verses.en: Thee they call the gods' defense, thee, O darbhá, Brahmaṇaspati; thee they call Indra's defense; thou defendest kingdoms.

verses.sa:
सपत्नक्षयणं दर्भ द्विषतस्तपनं हृदः ।
मणिं क्षत्रस्य वर्धनं तनूपानं कृणोमि ते ॥
verses.rom:
sapatnakshayanam darbha dvishatastapanam hridah |
manim kshatrasya vardhanam tanupanam krinomi te ||
verses.en: A destroyer of our rivals, O darbhá, burner of the heart of our hater—an amulet, increaser of dominion, protector of thy body, I make for thee.

verses.sa:
यत्समुद्रो अभ्यक्रन्दत्पर्जन्यो विद्युता सह ।
ततो हिरण्ययो बिन्दुस्ततो दर्भो अजायत ॥
verses.rom:
yatsamudro abhyakrandatparjanyo vidyuta saha |
tato hiranyayo bindustato darbho ajayata ||
verses.en: What the ocean roared (krand) against, [and] Parjanya with the lightning, therefrom was born the golden drop (bindú), therefrom the darbhá.

verses.sa:
औदुम्बरेण मणिना पुष्टिकामाय वेधसा ।
पशूनां सर्वेषां स्फातिं गोष्ठे मे सविता करत् ॥
verses.rom:
audumbarena manina pushtikamaya vedhasa |
pashunam sarvesham sphatim goshthe me savita karat ||
verses.en: With an amulet of udumbára, for the pious one desiring prosperity: may Savitar make in my cow-stall fatness (sphātí) of all cattle.

verses.sa:
यो नो अग्निर्गार्हपत्यः पशूनामधिपा असत्।
औदुम्बरो वृषा मणिः सं मा सृजतु पुष्ट्या ॥
verses.rom:
yo no agnirgarhapatyah pashunamadhipa asat|
audumbaro vrisha manih sam ma srijatu pushtya ||
verses.en: Whatever householder's fire of ours may be overlord of cattle: let the virile (vṛ́ṣan) amulet of udumbára unite me with prosperity.

verses.sa:
करीषिणीं फलवतीं स्वधामिरां च नो गृहे ।
औदुम्बरस्य तेजसा धाता पुष्टिं दधातु मे ॥
verses.rom:
karishinim phalavatim svadhamiram cha no grihe |
audumbarasya tejasa dhata pushtim dadhatu me ||
verses.en: Rich in manure, rich in fruit, svadhā́ and cheer (írā) in our house—prosperity let Dhātar assign to me through the keenness (téjas) of the [amulet] of udumbára.

verses.sa:
यद्द्विपाच्च चतुष्पाच्च यान्यन्नानि ये रसाः ।
गृह्णेऽहं त्वेषां भूमानं बिभ्रदौदुम्बरं मणिम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaddvipachcha chatushpachcha yanyannani ye rasah |
grihne'ham tvesham bhumanam bibhradaudumbaram manim ||
verses.en: Both what [is] two-footed and what four-footed, what foods [there are], what savors (rása)—I seize (grah) the abundance of them, wearing the amulet of udumbára.

verses.sa:
पुष्टिं पशूनां परि जग्रभाहं चतुष्पदां द्विपदां यच्च धान्यम् ।
पयः पशूनां रसमोषधीनां बृहस्पतिः सविता मे नि यच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
pushtim pashunam pari jagrabhaham chatushpadam dvipadam yachcha dhanyam |
payah pashunam rasamoshadhinam brihaspatih savita me ni yachchhat ||
verses.en: I have seized all (pári-) the prosperity of cattle, of quadrupeds, of bipeds, and what grain [there is]; the milk of cattle, the sap (rása) of herbs, may Bṛihaspati, may Savitar confirm to me.

verses.sa:
अहं पशूनामधिपा असानि मयि पुष्टं पुष्टपतिर्दधातु ।
मह्यमौदुम्बरो मणिर्द्रविणानि नि यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
aham pashunamadhipa asani mayi pushtam pushtapatirdadhatu |
mahyamaudumbaro manirdravinani ni yachchhatu ||
verses.en: Let me be the over-ruler of cattle; let the lord of prosperity (puṣṭá-) assign to me prosperity; let the amulet of udumbára confirm to me possessions (dráviṇa).

verses.sa:
