उप मौदुम्बरो मणिः प्रजया च धनेन च ।
इन्द्रेण जिन्वितो मणिरा मागन्त्सह वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
upa maudumbaro manih prajaya cha dhanena cha |
indrena jinvito manira magantsaha varchasa ||
verses.en: Unto me the amulet of udumbára, with both progeny and riches: the amulet quickened by Indra hath come to me together with splendor.

verses.sa:
देवो मणिः सपत्नहा धनसा धनसातये ।
पशोरन्नस्य भूमानं गवां स्फातिं नि यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
devo manih sapatnaha dhanasa dhanasataye |
pashorannasya bhumanam gavam sphatim ni yachchhatu ||
verses.en: The heavenly amulet, rival-slaying, riches-winning, in order to the winning of riches: let it confirm [to me] abundance of cattle, of food, [and] fatness of kine.

verses.sa:
यथाग्रे त्वं वनस्पते पुष्ट्या सह जज्ञिषे ।
एवा धनस्य मे स्फातिमा दधातु सरस्वती ॥
verses.rom:
yathagre tvam vanaspate pushtya saha jajnishe |
eva dhanasya me sphatima dadhatu sarasvati ||
verses.en: As in the beginning thou, O forest tree, wast born together with prosperity, so let Sarasvatī assign to me fatness of riches.

verses.sa:
आ मे धनं सरस्वती पयस्फातिं च धान्यम् ।
सिनीवाल्युपा वहादयं चौदुम्बरो मणिः ॥
verses.rom:
a me dhanam sarasvati payasphatim cha dhanyam |
sinivalyupa vahadayam chaudumbaro manih ||
verses.en: Riches, fatness of milk, and grain shall Sarasvatī, shall Sinīvālī, and this amulet of udumbára bring to me.

verses.sa:
त्वं मणीणामधिपा वृषासि त्वयि पुष्टं पुष्टपतिर्जजान ।
त्वयीमे वाजा द्रविणानि सर्वौदुम्बरः स त्वमस्मत्सहस्वारादारादरातिममतिं क्षुधं च ॥
verses.rom:
tvam maninamadhipa vrishasi tvayi pushtam pushtapatirjajana |
tvayime vaja dravinani sarvaudumbarah sa tvamasmatsahasvaradaradaratimamatim kshudham cha ||
verses.en: Thou art the virile (vṛ́ṣan) over-ruler of amulets; in thee the lord of prosperity generated prosperity; in thee [are] these powers (vā́ja), [are] all possessions; do thou here, O [amulet] of udumbára, force (sah) far away from us the niggard, misery, and hunger.

verses.sa:
ग्रामणीरसि ग्रामणीरुत्थाय अभिषिक्तोऽभि मा सिञ्च वर्चसा ।
तेजोऽसि तेजो मयि धारयाधि रयिरसि रयिं मे धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
gramanirasi gramanirutthaya abhishikto'bhi ma sincha varchasa |
tejo'si tejo mayi dharayadhi rayirasi rayim me dhehi ||
verses.en: Troop-leader art thou, arising a troop-leader; being anointed (abhisic), do thou anoint me with splendor; brilliancy art thou, brilliancy maintain thou upon me; wealth art thou, wealth assign thou to me.

verses.sa:
पुष्टिरसि पुष्ट्या मा समङ्ग्धि गृहमेधी गृहपतिं मा कृणु ।
औदुम्बरः स त्वमस्मासु धेहि रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं नि यच्छ रायस्पोषाय प्रति मुञ्चे अहं त्वाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pushtirasi pushtya ma samangdhi grihamedhi grihapatim ma krinu |
audumbarah sa tvamasmasu dhehi rayim cha nah sarvaviram ni yachchha rayasposhaya prati munche aham tvam ||
verses.en: Prosperity art thou, with prosperity anoint (añj) thou me completely; being house-sacrificer, make thou me householder; O [amulet] of udumbára, do thou here put in us and confirm to us wealth having all heroes; I fasten thee on in order to abundance of wealth.

verses.sa:
अयमौदुम्बरो मणिर्वीरो वीराय बध्यते ।
स नः सनिं मधुमतीं कृणोतु रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं नि यच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
ayamaudumbaro manirviro viraya badhyate |
sa nah sanim madhumatim krinotu rayim cha nah sarvaviram ni yachchhat ||
verses.en: This amulet of udumbára is bound, a hero, to a hero; let it make for us a winning rich in honey, and may it confirm to us wealth having all heroes.

verses.sa:
शतकाण्डो दुश्च्यवनः सहस्रपर्ण उत्तिरः ।
दर्भो य उग्र ओषधिस्तं ते बध्नाम्यायुषे ॥
verses.rom:
shatakando dushchyavanah sahasraparna uttirah |
darbho ya ugra oshadhistam te badhnamyayushe ||
verses.en: Hundred-jointed, hard to be stirred, thousand-leaved, uplifting (?)—the darbhá that is a formidable herb, that I bind on thee in order to [prolonged] life-time.

verses.sa:
नास्य केशान् प्र वपन्ति नोरसि ताडमा घ्नते ।
यस्मा अछिन्नपर्णेन दर्भेन शर्म यच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
nasya keshan pra vapanti norasi tadama ghnate |
yasma achhinnaparnena darbhena sharma yachchhati ||
verses.en: His hair they scatter not forth, they smite not blows on their breast [for him], to whom one yields refuge by the darbhá of uncut leaves.

verses.sa:
दिवि ते तूलमोषधे पृथिव्यामसि निष्ठितः ।
त्वया सहस्रकाण्डेनायुः प्र वर्धयामहे ॥
verses.rom:
divi te tulamoshadhe prithivyamasi nishthitah |
tvaya sahasrakandenayuh pra vardhayamahe ||
verses.en: In the sky is thy tuft, O herb; in the earth art thou set (ni-sthā); with thee, that hast a thousand joints, do we increase further our life-time.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो दिवो अत्यतृणत्तिस्र इमाः पृथिवीरुत ।
त्वयाहं दुर्हार्दो जिह्वां नि तृणद्मि वचांसि ॥
verses.rom:
tisro divo atyatrinattisra imah prithiviruta |
tvayaham durhardo jihvam ni trinadmi vachamsi ||
verses.en: Thou didst bore through the three skies, also these three earths; by thee do I bore into my enemy's (durhā́rd) tongue [and] utterances (vácas).

verses.sa:
त्वमसि सहमानोऽहमस्मि सहस्वान् ।
उभौ सहस्वन्तौ भूत्वा सपत्नान् सहिषीवहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamasi sahamano'hamasmi sahasvan |
ubhau sahasvantau bhutva sapatnan sahishivahi ||
verses.en: Thou art overpowering; I am full of power; may we, both of us, becoming full of power, overpower our rivals.

verses.sa:
सहस्व नो अभिमातिं सहस्व पृतनायतः ।
सहस्व सर्वान् दुर्हार्दः सुहार्दो मे बहून् कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sahasva no abhimatim sahasva pritanayatah |
sahasva sarvan durhardah suhardo me bahun kridhi ||
verses.en: Do thou overpower our hostile plotter, overpower those that fight us; overpower all enemies (durhā́rd); make for me many friends (suhā́rd).

verses.sa:
दर्भेण देवजातेन दिवि ष्टम्भेन शश्वदित्।
तेनाहं शश्वतो जनामसनं सनवानि च ॥
verses.rom:
darbhena devajatena divi shtambhena shashvadit|
tenaham shashvato janamasanam sanavani cha ||
verses.en: With the darbhá, god-born, constantly sky-propping—with it I have constantly won and shall win men (jána).

verses.sa:
प्रियं मा दर्भ कृणु ब्रह्मराजन्याभ्यां शूद्राय चार्याय च ।
यस्मै च कामयामहे सर्वस्मै च विपश्यते ॥
verses.rom:
priyam ma darbha krinu brahmarajanyabhyam shudraya charyaya cha |
yasmai cha kamayamahe sarvasmai cha vipashyate ||
verses.en: Make me, O darbhá, dear to Brahman-and-Kshatriya, both to Çūdra and to Āryan, and to whomsoever we desire, and to every one that looks abroad.

verses.sa:
यो जायमानः पृथिवीमदृंहद्यो अस्तभ्नादन्तरिक्षं दिवं च ।
यं बिभ्रतं ननु पाप्मा विवेद स नोऽयं दर्भो वरुणो दिवा कः ॥
verses.rom:
yo jayamanah prithivimadrimhadyo astabhnadantariksham divam cha |
yam bibhratam nanu papma viveda sa no'yam darbho varuno diva kah ||
verses.en: He that, being born, made firm the earth, that propped (stabh) the atmosphere and the sky, whose wearer evil hath not found out—that darbhá here [is] our supporter [and] blessing.

verses.sa:
सपत्नहा शतकाण्डः सहस्वान् ओषधीनां प्रथमः सं बभूव ।
स नोऽयं दर्भः परि पातु विश्वतस्तेन साक्षीय पृतनाः पृतन्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
sapatnaha shatakandah sahasvan oshadhinam prathamah sam babhuva |
sa no'yam darbhah pari patu vishvatastena sakshiya pritanah pritanyatah ||
verses.en: Rival-slaying, hundred-jointed, powerful, came into being the first of plants; let that darbhá here protect us all about; by it may I overpower fighters, them that fight [against me].

verses.sa:
सहस्रार्घः शतकाण्डः पयस्वान् अपामग्निर्वीरुधां राजसूयम् ।
स नोऽयं दर्भः परि पातु विश्वतो देवो मणिरायुषा सं सृजाति नः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrarghah shatakandah payasvan apamagnirvirudham rajasuyam |
sa no'yam darbhah pari patu vishvato devo manirayusha sam srijati nah ||
verses.en: Of thousand-fold worth, hundred-jointed, rich in milk, fire of the waters, consecration (rājasū́ya) of plants—let this darbhá here protect us all about; may the divine amulet unite us with [prolonged] life-time.

verses.sa:
घृतादुल्लुप्तो मधुमान् पयस्वान् भूमिदृंहोऽच्युतश्च्यावयिष्णुः ।
नुदन्त्सपत्नान् अधरांश्च कृण्वन् दर्भा रोह महतामिन्द्रियेण ॥
verses.rom:
ghritadullupto madhuman payasvan bhumidrimho'chyutashchyavayishnuh |
nudantsapatnan adharamshcha krinvan darbha roha mahatamindriyena ||
verses.en: Snatched out of ghee, rich in honey, rich in milk, earth-establishing, unstirred, stirring [other things], thrusting away and putting down rivals—ascend thou, O darbhá, with the energy (indriyá) of the great ones.

verses.sa:
त्वं भूमिमत्येष्योजसा त्वं वेद्यां सीदसि चारुरध्वरे ।
त्वां पवित्रमृषयोऽभरन्त त्वं पुनीहि दुरितान्यस्मत् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam bhumimatyeshyojasa tvam vedyam sidasi charuradhvare |
tvam pavitramrishayo'bharanta tvam punihi duritanyasmat ||
verses.en: Thou goest across the earth with force; thou sittest beauteous (cā́ru) on the sacrificial hearth at the sacrifice; the seers bore thee [as] purifier; do thou purify us from difficulties.

verses.sa:
तीक्ष्णो राजा विषासही रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिः ।
ओजो देवानां बलमुग्रमेतत्तं ते बध्नामि जरसे स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
tikshno raja vishasahi rakshoha vishvacharshanih |
ojo devanam balamugrametattam te badhnami jarase svastaye ||
verses.en: A keen (tīkṣṇá) king, of mighty power, demon-slaying, belonging to all men (-carṣaṇí), force of the gods, formidable strength [is] that; I bind it on thee in order to old age, to well-being.

verses.sa:
दर्भेण त्वं कृणवद्वीर्याणि दर्भं बिभ्रदात्मना मा व्यथिष्ठाः ।
अतिष्ठाय वर्चसाधान्यान्त्सूर्य इवा भाहि प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ॥
verses.rom:
darbhena tvam krinavadviryani darbham bibhradatmana ma vyathishthah |
atishthaya varchasadhanyantsurya iva bhahi pradishashchatasrah ||
verses.en: With the darbhá thou shalt do heroic deeds; wearing the darbhá, do thou not stagger by thyself; excelling (ati-sthā) over others with splendor, shine thou like the sun unto the four quarters.

verses.sa:
जाङ्गिडोऽसि जङ्गिडो रक्षितासि जङ्गिडः ।
द्विपाच्चतुष्पादस्माकं सर्वं रक्षतु जङ्गिडः ॥
verses.rom:
jangido'si jangido rakshitasi jangidah |
dvipachchatushpadasmakam sarvam rakshatu jangidah ||
verses.en: Jan̄giḍá art though, jan̄giḍá; defender art thou, jan̄giḍá; what of ours is two-footed, four-footed—let jan̄giḍá defend it all.

verses.sa:
या गृत्स्यस्त्रिपञ्चाशीः शतं कृत्याकृतश्च ये ।
सर्वान् विनक्तु तेजसोऽरसां जङ्गिडस्करत् ॥
verses.rom:
ya gritsyastripanchashih shatam krityakritashcha ye |
sarvan vinaktu tejaso'rasam jangidaskarat ||
verses.en: The witchcrafts that are thrice fifty, and the witchcraft-makers that are a hundred—may the jan̄giḍá make them all of vanished brilliancy (-téjas) [and] sapless.

verses.sa:
अरसं कृत्रिमं नादमरसाः सप्त विस्रसः ।
अपेतो जङ्गिडामतिमिषुमस्तेव शातय ॥
verses.rom:
arasam kritrimam nadamarasah sapta visrasah |
apeto jangidamatimishumasteva shataya ||
verses.en: Sapless the artificial noise, sapless the seven that fall apart; away from here, O jan̄giḍá, make fall (çat) misery, as an archer (ástṛ) an arrow.

verses.sa:
कृत्यादूषण एवायमथो अरातिदूषणः ।
अथो सहस्वाञ्जङ्गिडः प्र न आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
krityadushana evayamatho aratidushanah |
atho sahasvanjangidah pra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en: A spoiler of witchcraft verily is this, likewise a spoiler of niggardry; likewise may the powerful jan̄giḍá lengthen out our life-times.

verses.sa:
स जङ्गिडस्य महिमा परि णः पातु विश्वतः ।
विष्कन्धं येन सासह संस्कन्धमोज ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
sa jangidasya mahima pari nah patu vishvatah |
vishkandham yena sasaha samskandhamoja ojasa ||
verses.en: Let that greatness of the jan̄giḍá protect us all about, wherewith [it] overpowered the víṣkandha with force, [being] a counteracting force (?).

verses.sa:
त्रिष्ट्वा देवा अजनयन् निष्ठितं भूम्यामधि ।
तमु त्वाङ्गिरा इति ब्राह्मणाः पूर्व्या विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
trishtva deva ajanayan nishthitam bhumyamadhi |
tamu tvangira iti brahmanah purvya viduh ||
verses.en: Thrice the gods generated thee that art settled (ni-sthā) upon the earth; and Brahmans of old know thee thus as An̄giras by name.

verses.sa:
न त्वा पूर्वा ओषधयो न त्वा तरन्ति या नवाः ।
विबाध उग्रो जङ्गिडः परिपाणः सुमङ्गलः ॥
verses.rom:
na tva purva oshadhayo na tva taranti ya navah |
vibadha ugro jangidah paripanah sumangalah ||
verses.en: Not the former herbs surpass thee, not thee the recent; a formidable dispeller [is] the jan̄giḍá, a protector round about, of good omen.

verses.sa:
अथोपदान भगवो जाङ्गिडामितवीर्य ।
पुरा त उग्रा ग्रसत उपेन्द्रो वीर्यं ददौ ॥
verses.rom:
athopadana bhagavo jangidamitavirya |
pura ta ugra grasata upendro viryam dadau ||
verses.en: So then when thou didst come into being, O jan̄giḍá, O thou of unmeasured heroism, Indra of old, O formidable one, in the beginning (agratás), gave unto thee heroism.

verses.sa:
उग्र इत्ते वनस्पत इन्द्र ओज्मानमा दधौ ।
अमीवाः सर्वाश्चातयं जहि रक्षांस्योषधे ॥
verses.rom:
ugra itte vanaspata indra ojmanama dadhau |
amivah sarvashchatayam jahi rakshamsyoshadhe ||
verses.en: To thee, O forest tree, the formidable Indra imparted (ā-dhā) formidableness; expelling all diseases (ámīvā), do thou smite the demons, O herb.

verses.sa:
आशरीकं विशरीकं बलासं पृष्ट्यामयम् ।
तक्मानं विश्वशारदमरसां जङ्गिडस्करत् ॥
verses.rom:
asharikam visharikam balasam prishtyamayam |
takmanam vishvasharadamarasam jangidaskarat ||
verses.en: The crusher, the burster, the balā́sa, the side-ache, the takmán of every autumn, may the jan̄giḍá make sapless.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य नाम गृह्णन्त ऋषयो जङ्गिडं ददुः ।
देवा यं चक्रुर्भेषजमग्रे विष्कन्धदूषणम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya nama grihnanta rishayo jangidam daduh |
deva yam chakrurbheshajamagre vishkandhadushanam ||
verses.en: Taking (grah) the name of Indra, the seers gave the jan̄giḍá, which the gods in the beginning made a remedy, spoiler of the víṣkandha.

verses.sa:
स नो रक्षतु जङ्गिडो धनपालो धनेव ।
देवा यं चक्रुर्ब्राह्मणाः परिपाणमरातिहम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no rakshatu jangido dhanapalo dhaneva |
deva yam chakrurbrahmanah paripanamaratiham ||
verses.en: Let that jan̄giḍá defend us, as a protector of riches his riches; which jan̄giḍá the gods, the Brahmans, made a protector round about, slayer of niggards.

verses.sa:
दुर्हार्दः संघोरं चक्षुः पापकृत्वानमागमम् ।
तांस्त्वं सहस्रचक्षो प्रतीबोधेन नाशय परिपाणोऽसि जङ्गिडः ॥
verses.rom:
durhardah samghoram chakshuh papakritvanamagamam |
tamstvam sahasrachaksho pratibodhena nashaya paripano'si jangidah ||
verses.en: The enemy of terrible aspect (-cákṣús), the evil-doer that has come—them do thou, O thousand-eyed one, make to vanish by thy watchfulness (? pratībodhá); thou art jan̄giḍá that protects round about.

verses.sa:
परि मा दिवः परि मा पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षात्परि मा वीरुद्भ्यः ।
परि मा भूतात्परि मोत भव्याद्दिशोदिशो जङ्गिडः पात्वस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
pari ma divah pari ma prithivyah paryantarikshatpari ma virudbhyah |
pari ma bhutatpari mota bhavyaddishodisho jangidah patvasman ||
verses.en: Me from the sky, me from the earth, from the atmosphere, me from the plants, me from what is, and me from what is to be—from every direction let the jan̄giḍá protect us about.

verses.sa:
य ऋष्णवो देवकृता य उतो ववृतेऽन्यः ।
सर्वांस्तान् विश्वभेषजोऽरसां जङ्गिडस्करत् ॥
verses.rom:
ya rishnavo devakrita ya uto vavrite'nyah |
sarvamstan vishvabheshajo'rasam jangidaskarat ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft-]workers are made by the gods, and also what from mortals—all those may the all-healing jan̄giḍá make sapless.

verses.sa:
शतवारो अनीनशद्यक्ष्मान् रक्षांसि तेजसा ।
आरोहन् वर्चसा सह मणिर्दुर्णामचातनः ॥
verses.rom:
shatavaro aninashadyakshman rakshamsi tejasa |
arohan varchasa saha manirdurnamachatanah ||
verses.en: The çatávāra hath by its keenness (téjas) made to vanish the yákṣmas, the demons, mounting together with splendor, an amulet that expels the ill-named.

verses.sa:
शृङ्गाभ्यां रक्षो नुदते मूलेन यातुधान्यः ।
मध्येन यक्ष्मं बाधते नैनं पाप्माति तत्रति ॥
verses.rom:
shringabhyam raksho nudate mulena yatudhanyah |
madhyena yakshmam badhate nainam papmati tatrati ||
verses.en: With its two horns it thrusts away the demon, with its root the sorceresses; with its middle it drives off (bādh) the yákṣma; no evil overpasses it.

verses.sa:
ये यक्ष्मासो अर्भका महान्तो ये च शब्दिनः ।
सर्वां दुर्णामहा मणिः शतवारो अनीनशत् ॥
verses.rom:
ye yakshmaso arbhaka mahanto ye cha shabdinah |
sarvam durnamaha manih shatavaro aninashat ||
verses.en: The yákṣmas that are petty, and they that are great, noisy—all of them the çatávāra amulet, slayer of the ill-named, hath made vanish.

verses.sa:
शतं वीरान् अजनयच्छतं यक्ष्मान् अपावपत्।
दुर्णाम्नः सर्वान् हत्वाव रक्षांसि धूनुते ॥
verses.rom:
shatam viran ajanayachchhatam yakshman apavapat|
durnamnah sarvan hatvava rakshamsi dhunute ||
verses.en: A hundred heroes it generated; a hundred yákṣmas it scattered away; having slain all the ill-named ones, it shakes down the demons.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यशृङ्ग ऋषभः शातवारो अयं मणिः ।
दुर्णाम्नः सर्वांस्तृध्वाव रक्षांस्यक्रमीत् ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyashringa rishabhah shatavaro ayam manih |
durnamnah sarvamstridhvava rakshamsyakramit ||
verses.en: A golden-horned bull [is] this amulet of çatávāra; having shattered (tṛh) all the ill-named ones, it hath trodden down the demons.

verses.sa:
शतमहं दुर्णाम्नीनां गन्धर्वाप्सरसां शतम् ।
शतं शश्वन्वतीनां शतवारेण वारये ॥
verses.rom:
shatamaham durnamninam gandharvapsarasam shatam |
shatam shashvanvatinam shatavarena varaye ||
verses.en: With the çatávāra I ward off (vāraya-) a hundred of the ill-named ones (f.), a hundred of the Gandharvas-and-Apsarases, and a hundred of the doglike ones (f.).

verses.sa:
इदं वर्चो अग्निना दत्तमागन् भर्गो यशः सह ओजो वयो बलम् ।
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्यानि च वीर्याणि तान्यग्निः प्र ददातु मे ॥
verses.rom:
idam varcho agnina dattamagan bhargo yashah saha ojo vayo balam |
trayastrimshadyani cha viryani tanyagnih pra dadatu me ||
verses.en: This splendor hath come, given by Agni, brightness (bhárga), glory, power, force, vigor (vájas), strength; and the heroisms that are thirty-three—those let Agni give forth to me.

verses.sa:
वर्च आ धेहि मे तन्वां सह ओजो वयो बलम् ।
इन्द्रियाय त्वा कर्मणे वीर्याय प्रति गृह्णामि शतशारदाय ॥
verses.rom:
varcha a dhehi me tanvam saha ojo vayo balam |
indriyaya tva karmane viryaya prati grihnami shatasharadaya ||
verses.en: Splendor set thou in my body (tanū́), power, force, vigor, strength; unto Indra-like action, unto heroism, unto [life] of a hundred autumns, do I accept thee.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जे त्वा बलाय त्वौजसे सहसे त्वा ।
अभिभूयाय त्वा राष्ट्रभृत्याय पर्यूहामि शतशारदाय ॥
verses.rom:
urje tva balaya tvaujase sahase tva |
abhibhuyaya tva rashtrabhrityaya paryuhami shatasharadaya ||
verses.en: Unto refreshment thee, unto strength thee, unto force, unto power thee, unto superiority thee do I carry about, unto the wearing of royalty for a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
ऋतुभ्यष्ट्वार्तवेभ्यो माद्भ्यः संवत्सरेभ्यः ।
धात्रे विधात्रे समृधे भूतस्य पतये यजे ॥
verses.rom:
ritubhyashtvartavebhyo madbhyah samvatsarebhyah |
dhatre vidhatre samridhe bhutasya pataye yaje ||
verses.en: Thee with the seasons, with them of the seasons; thee unto lifetime, unto splendor; with the brilliancy of the year—with that we make [thee] cheek by jowl.

verses.sa:
न तं यक्ष्मा अरुन्धते नैनं शपथो अश्नुते ।
यं भेषजस्य गुल्गुलोः सुरभिर्गन्धो अश्नुते ॥
verses.rom:
na tam yakshma arundhate nainam shapatho ashnute |
yam bheshajasya gulguloh surabhirgandho ashnute ||

verses.sa:
विष्वञ्चस्तस्माद्यक्ष्मा मृगा अश्वा इवेरते ।
यद्गुल्गुलु सैन्धवं यद्वाप्यसि समुद्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvanchastasmadyakshma mriga ashva iverate |
yadgulgulu saindhavam yadvapyasi samudriyam ||

verses.sa: उभयोरग्रभं नामास्मा अरिष्टतातये ॥
verses.rom: ubhayoragrabham namasma arishtatataye ||

prose.en:
1. Yákṣmas obstruct him not, a curse attains him not, whom the agreeable odor of the healing gúggulu attains.

2. From him the yákṣmas scatter away, like antelopes from a wild beast. If, O gúggulu, thou art from the river, or if also from the ocean, the name of both have I taken (grah), that this man may be uninjured.

verses.sa:
ऐतु देवस्त्रायमाणः कुष्ठो हिमवतस्परि ।
तक्मानं सर्वं नाशय सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः ॥
verses.rom:
aitu devastrayamanah kushtho himavataspari |
takmanam sarvam nashaya sarvashcha yatudhanyah ||

verses.sa:
त्रीणि ते कुष्ठ नामानि नद्यमारो नद्यारिषः ।
नद्यायं पुरुषो रिषत्।
यस्मै परिब्रवीमि त्वा सायंप्रातरथो दिवा ॥
verses.rom:
trini te kushtha namani nadyamaro nadyarishah |
nadyayam purusho rishat|
yasmai paribravimi tva sayamprataratho diva ||

verses.sa:
जीवला नाम ते माता जीवन्तो नाम ते पिता ।
नद्यायं पुरुषो रिषत्।
यस्मै परिब्रवीमि त्वा सायंप्रातरथो दिवा ॥
verses.rom:
jivala nama te mata jivanto nama te pita |
nadyayam purusho rishat|
yasmai paribravimi tva sayamprataratho diva ||

verses.sa:
उत्तमो अस्योषधीनामनड्वान् जगतामिव व्याघ्रः श्वपदामिव ।
नद्यायं पुरुषो रिषत्।
यस्मै परिब्रवीमि त्वा सायंप्रातरथो दिवा ॥
verses.rom:
uttamo asyoshadhinamanadvan jagatamiva vyaghrah shvapadamiva |
nadyayam purusho rishat|
yasmai paribravimi tva sayamprataratho diva ||

verses.sa:
त्रिः शाम्बुभ्यो अङ्गिरेभ्यस्त्रिरादित्येभ्यस्परि ।
त्रिर्जातो विश्वदेवेभ्यः ।
स कुष्ठो विश्वभेषजः साकं सोमेन तिष्ठति ।
अश्वत्थो देवसदनस्तृतीयस्यामितो दिवि ।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं ततः कुष्ठो अजायत ।
स कुष्ठो विश्वभेषजः साकं सोमेन तिष्ठति ।
हिरण्ययी नौरचरद्धिरण्यबन्धना दिवि ।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं ततः कुष्ठो अजायत ।
स कुष्ठो विश्वभेषजः साकं सोमेन तिष्ठति ।
यत्र नावप्रभ्रंशनं यत्र हिमवतः शिरः ।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं ततः कुष्ठो अजायत ।
स कुष्ठो विश्वभेषजः साकं सोमेन तिष्ठति ।
यं त्वा वेद पूर्व इक्ष्वाको यं वा त्वा कुष्ठ काम्यः ।
यं वा वसो यमात्स्यस्तेनासि विश्वभेषजः ॥
verses.rom:
trih shambubhyo angirebhyastriradityebhyaspari |
trirjato vishvadevebhyah |
sa kushtho vishvabheshajah sakam somena tishthati |
ashvattho devasadanastritiyasyamito divi |
tatramritasya chakshanam tatah kushtho ajayata |
sa kushtho vishvabheshajah sakam somena tishthati |
hiranyayi nauracharaddhiranyabandhana divi |
tatramritasya chakshanam tatah kushtho ajayata |
sa kushtho vishvabheshajah sakam somena tishthati |
yatra navaprabhramshanam yatra himavatah shirah |
tatramritasya chakshanam tatah kushtho ajayata |
sa kushtho vishvabheshajah sakam somena tishthati |
yam tva veda purva ikshvako yam va tva kushtha kamyah |
yam va vaso yamatsyastenasi vishvabheshajah ||

verses.sa:
शीर्षशोकं तृतीयकं सदंदिर्यश्च हायनः ।
तक्मानं विश्वधावीर्याधराञ्चं परा सुव ॥
verses.rom:
shirshashokam tritiyakam sadamdiryashcha hayanah |
takmanam vishvadhaviryadharancham para suva ||

prose.en:
9. Thou whom Ikshvāku of old knew, or thou whom Kushṭhakāmya [knew], whom Vāyasa, whom Mātsya—thereby art thou all-healing.

10. The head-paining, the tertian, and that which is constant, is hibernal—the takmán, O thou of power in every direction, do thou impel (sū) away downward.

verses.sa:
यन् मे छिद्रं मनसो यच्च वाचः सरस्वती मन्युमन्तं जगाम ।
विश्वैस्तद्देवैः सह संविदानः सं दधातु बृहस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yan me chhidram manaso yachcha vachah sarasvati manyumantam jagama |
vishvaistaddevaih saha samvidanah sam dadhatu brihaspatih ||
verses.en: What that is defective (chidrá) of my mind, and what of my voice hath found (? jagā́ma) Sarasvatī enraged, let Bṛihaspati, in concord with all the gods, mend (sam-dhā) that.

verses.sa:
मा न आपो मेधां मा ब्रह्म प्र मथिष्टन ।
सुष्यदा यूयं स्यन्दध्वमुपहूतोऽहं सुमेधा वर्चस्वी ॥
verses.rom:
ma na apo medham ma brahma pra mathishtana |
sushyada yuyam syandadhvamupahuto'ham sumedha varchasvi ||
verses.en: Do not ye, O waters, devastate (pra-math) our wisdom nor our bráhman; come ye flowing with easy flow, being invoked; [be] I of good wisdom, having splendor.

verses.sa:
मा नो मेधां मा नो दीक्षां मा नो हिंसिष्टं यत्तपः ।
शिवा नः शं सन्त्वायुषे शिवा भवन्तु मातरः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no medham ma no diksham ma no himsishtam yattapah |
shiva nah sham santvayushe shiva bhavantu matarah ||
verses.en: Do not ye injure our wisdom, nor our consecration, nor what ardor (tápas) is ours; be they propitious to us in order to [prolonged] life-time; let them become [our] propitious mothers.

verses.sa:
या नः पीपरदश्विना ज्योतिष्मती तमस्तिरः ।
तामस्मे रासतामिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya nah piparadashvina jyotishmati tamastirah |
tamasme rasatamisham ||
verses.en: That food (? íṣ) O Açvins, which, full of light, shall make us pass through the darkness, may ye give (rā) to us.

verses.sa:
भद्रमिच्छन्त ऋषयः स्वर्विदस्तपो दीक्षामुपनिषेदुरग्रे ।
ततो राष्ट्रं बलमोजश्च जातं तदस्मै देवा उपसंनमन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
bhadramichchhanta rishayah svarvidastapo dikshamupanisheduragre |
tato rashtram balamojashcha jatam tadasmai deva upasamnamantu ||
verses.en: Desiring what is excellent, the heaven-finding seers in the beginning sat down in attendance upon (upa-ni-sad) ardor [and] consecration; thence [is] born royalty, strength, and force; let the gods make that submissive to this man.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म होता ब्रह्म यज्ञा ब्रह्मणा स्वरवो मिताः ।
अध्वर्युर्ब्रह्मणो जातो ब्रह्मणोऽन्तर्हितं हविः ॥
verses.rom:
brahma hota brahma yajna brahmana svaravo mitah |
adhvaryurbrahmano jato brahmano'ntarhitam havih ||
verses.en: The bráhman is invoker (hótṛ) the bráhman is the sacrifice; by the bráhman the sacrificial posts are set up; the officiating priest (adhvaryú) is born from the bráhman; within the bráhman is put the oblation.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म स्रुचो घृतवतीर्ब्रह्मणा वेदिरुद्धिता ।
ब्रह्म यज्ञस्य तत्त्वं च ऋत्विजो ये हविष्कृतः ।
शमिताय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
brahma srucho ghritavatirbrahmana vediruddhita |
brahma yajnasya tattvam cha ritvijo ye havishkritah |
shamitaya svaha ||
verses.en: The bráhman is the sacrificial spoons filled with ghee; by the bráhman is the sacrificial hearth set up (ud-dhā) and the bráhman is the essence (tattvá) of the sacrifice—the priests that are oblation-makers: to the slaughtered [victim] hail!

verses.sa:
अंहोमुचे प्र भरे मनीषामा सुत्राव्णे सुमतिमावृणानः ।
इममिन्द्र प्रति हव्यं गृभाय सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः ॥
verses.rom:
amhomuche pra bhare manishama sutravne sumatimavrinanah |
imamindra prati havyam gribhaya satyah santu yajamanasya kamah ||
verses.en: To him who frees from distress I bring forward my devotion (manīṣā́), unto him who rescues well, choosing to myself his favor; accept, O Indra, this oblation; let the desires of the sacrificer be realized.

verses.sa:
अंहोमुचं व्र्षभं यज्ञियानां विराजन्तं प्रथममध्वराणम् ।
अपां नपातमश्विना हुवे धिय इन्द्रियेण त इन्द्रियं दत्तमोजः ॥
verses.rom:
amhomucham vrshabham yajniyanam virajantam prathamamadhvaranam |
apam napatamashvina huve dhiya indriyena ta indriyam dattamojah ||
verses.en: Him who frees from distress, the bull of the worshipful, him that shines forth (vi-rāj), the first of the sacrifices (adhvará), the child of the waters, O Açvins, I call with prayer (dhī́); do ye with Indra give me Indra-like force.

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह ।
अग्निर्मा तत्र नयत्वग्निर्मेधा दधातु मे ।
अग्नये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yatra brahmavido yanti dikshaya tapasa saha |
agnirma tatra nayatvagnirmedha dadhatu me |
agnaye svaha ||
verses.en: Whither the brahman-knowers go, along with consecration, with ardor—thither let Agni conduct me; let Agni impart (dhā) to me wisdom: to Agni hail!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह ।
वायुर्मा तत्र नयतु वायुः प्रणान् दधातु मे वायवे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yatra brahmavido yanti dikshaya tapasa saha |
vayurma tatra nayatu vayuh pranan dadhatu me vayave svaha ||
verses.en: Whither the etc. etc.—thither let Vāyu conduct me; let Vāyu impart to me breaths: to Vāyu hail!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह ।
सूर्यो मा तत्र नयतु चक्षुः सूर्यो दधातु मे ।
सूर्याय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yatra brahmavido yanti dikshaya tapasa saha |
suryo ma tatra nayatu chakshuh suryo dadhatu me |
suryaya svaha ||
verses.en: Whither the etc. etc.—thither let the sun conduct me; let the sun impart to me sight: to the sun hail!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह ।
चन्द्रो मा तत्र नयतु मनश्चन्द्रो दधातु मे ।
चन्द्राय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yatra brahmavido yanti dikshaya tapasa saha |
chandro ma tatra nayatu manashchandro dadhatu me |
chandraya svaha ||
verses.en: Whither the etc. etc.—thither let the moon (candrá) conduct me; let the moon impart to me mind: to the moon hail!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह ।
सोमो मा तत्र नयतु पयः सोमो दधातु मे ।
सोमाय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yatra brahmavido yanti dikshaya tapasa saha |
somo ma tatra nayatu payah somo dadhatu me |
somaya svaha ||
verses.en: Whither the etc. etc.—thither let Soma conduct me; let Soma impart to me milk: to Soma hail!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह ।
इन्द्रो मा तत्र नयतु बलमिन्द्रो दधातु मे ।
इन्द्राय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yatra brahmavido yanti dikshaya tapasa saha |
indro ma tatra nayatu balamindro dadhatu me |
indraya svaha ||
verses.en: Whither the etc. etc.—thither let Indra conduct me; let Indra impart to me strength: to Indra hail!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह ।
आपो मा तत्र नयत्वमृतं मोप तिष्ठतु ।
अद्भ्यः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yatra brahmavido yanti dikshaya tapasa saha |
apo ma tatra nayatvamritam mopa tishthatu |
adbhyah svaha ||
verses.en: Whither the etc. etc.—thither let the waters conduct me; let immortality (amṛ́ta) approach (upa-sthā) me: to the waters hail!

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मविदो यान्ति दीक्षया तपसा सह ।
ब्रह्मा मा तत्र नयतु ब्रह्मा ब्रह्म दधातु मे ।
ब्रह्मणे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yatra brahmavido yanti dikshaya tapasa saha |
brahma ma tatra nayatu brahma brahma dadhatu me |
brahmane svaha ||
verses.en: Whither the etc. etc.—thither let Brahmán conduct me; let Brahmán impart to me bráhman: to Brahmán hail!

verses.sa:
आयुषोऽसि प्रतरणं विप्रं भेषजमुच्यसे ।
तदाञ्जन त्वं शंताते शमापो अभयं कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayusho'si prataranam vipram bheshajamuchyase |
tadanjana tvam shamtate shamapo abhayam kritam ||
verses.en: Thou art an extender of life-time; all-healing art thou called; so, O ointment, do thou [make] wealfulness; make, O ye waters, weal [and] fearlessness.

verses.sa:
यो हरिमा जायान्योऽङ्गभेदो विसल्पकः ।
सर्वं ते यक्ष्ममङ्गेभ्यो बहिर्निर्हन्त्वाञ्जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo harima jayanyo'ngabhedo visalpakah |
sarvam te yakshmamangebhyo bahirnirhantvanjanam ||
verses.en: What the jaundice is, the jāyā́nya, the limb-splitter, the visálpaka—all yákṣma from thy limbs let the ointment expel (nir-han) out.

verses.sa:
आञ्जनं पृथिव्यां जातं भद्रं पुरुषजीवनम् ।
कृणोत्वप्रमायुकं रथजूतिमनागसम् ॥
verses.rom:
anjanam prithivyam jatam bhadram purushajivanam |
krinotvapramayukam rathajutimanagasam ||
verses.en: The ointment, born on the earth, excellent, giving life to men—let it make [me] unperishing, of chariot-swiftness, free from offense.

verses.sa:
प्राण प्राणं त्रायस्वासो असवे मृड ।
निर्ऋते निर्ऋत्या नः पाशेभ्यो मुञ्च ॥
verses.rom:
prana pranam trayasvaso asave mrida |
nirrite nirritya nah pashebhyo muncha ||
verses.en: O breath, rescue thou breath; O life-breath (ásu), be gracious to life-breath; O destruction, free us from the fetters of destruction.

verses.sa:
सिन्धोर्गर्भोऽसि विद्युतां पुष्पम् ।
वातः प्राणः सूर्यश्चक्षुर्दिवस्पयः ॥
verses.rom:
sindhorgarbho'si vidyutam pushpam |
vatah pranah suryashchakshurdivaspayah ||
verses.en: Embryo of the river art thou, flower of the lightnings; the wind [thy] breath, the sun [thine] eye, from the sky [thy] milk.

verses.sa:
देवाञ्जन त्रैककुद परि मा पाहि विश्वतः ।
न त्वा तरन्त्योषधयो बाह्याः पर्वतीया उत ॥
verses.rom:
devanjana traikakuda pari ma pahi vishvatah |
na tva tarantyoshadhayo bahyah parvatiya uta ||
verses.en: O divine ointment, thou from the three-peaked [mountain], do thou protect me all about; the herbs do not surpass (tṛ) thee—those from abroad and those from the mountains.

verses.sa:
वीदं मध्यमवासृपद्रक्षोहामीवचातनः ।
अमीवाः सर्वाश्चातयन् नाशयदभिभा इतः ॥
verses.rom:
vidam madhyamavasripadrakshohamivachatanah |
amivah sarvashchatayan nashayadabhibha itah ||
verses.en: The demon-slayer, disease-expeller, hath crept down over the middle here, expelling all diseases, making portents vanish from here.

verses.sa:
बह्विदं राजन् वरुणानृतमाह पूरुषः ।
तस्मात्सहस्रवीर्य मुञ्च नः पर्यंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
bahvidam rajan varunanritamaha purushah |
tasmatsahasravirya muncha nah paryamhasah ||
verses.en: Much untruth, O king Varuṇa, doth man (pū́ruṣa) say here; from that sin (áṅhas) do thou free us, O thou of thousand-fold heroism.

verses.sa:
यदापो अघ्न्या इति वरुणेति यदूचिम ।
तस्मात्सहस्रवीर्य मुञ्च नः पर्यंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yadapo aghnya iti varuneti yaduchima |
tasmatsahasravirya muncha nah paryamhasah ||
verses.en: In that we have said O waters, O inviolable [kine], O Varuṇa, from that sin do thou free us, O thou of thousand-fold heroism.

verses.sa:
मित्रश्च त्वा वरुणश्चानुप्रेयतुराञ्जन ।
तौ त्वानुगत्य दूरं भोगाय पुनरोहतुः ॥
verses.rom:
mitrashcha tva varunashchanupreyaturanjana |
tau tvanugatya duram bhogaya punarohatuh ||
verses.en: Both Mitra and Varuṇa went forth after thee, O ointment; they, having gone far after thee, brought thee back for enjoyment (bhogá).

verses.sa:
ऋणादृणमिव सं नय कृत्यां कृत्याकृतो गृहम् ।
चक्षुर्मन्त्रस्य दुर्हार्दः पृष्टीरपि शृणाञ्जन ॥
verses.rom:
rinadrinamiva sam naya krityam krityakrito griham |
chakshurmantrasya durhardah prishtirapi shrinanjana ||

verses.sa:
यदस्मासु दुष्वप्न्यं यद्गोषु यच्च नो गृहे ।
अनामगस्तं च दुर्हार्दः प्रियः प्रति मुञ्चताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadasmasu dushvapnyam yadgoshu yachcha no grihe |
anamagastam cha durhardah priyah prati munchatam ||

verses.sa:
अपामूर्ज ओजसो वावृधानमग्नेर्जातमधि जातवेदसः ।
चतुर्वीरं पर्वतीयं यदाञ्जनं दिशः प्रदिशः करदिच्छिवास्ते ॥
verses.rom:
apamurja ojaso vavridhanamagnerjatamadhi jatavedasah |
chaturviram parvatiyam yadanjanam dishah pradishah karadichchhivaste ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्वीरं बध्यत आञ्जनं ते सर्वा दिशो अभयास्ते भवन्तु ।
ध्रुवस्तिष्ठासि सवितेव चार्य इमा विशो अभि हरन्तु ते बलिम् ॥
verses.rom:
chaturviram badhyata anjanam te sarva disho abhayaste bhavantu |
dhruvastishthasi saviteva charya ima visho abhi harantu te balim ||

verses.sa:
आक्ष्वैकं मणिमेकं कृणुष्व स्नाह्येकेना पिबैकमेषाम् ।
चतुर्वीरं नैर्ऋतेभ्यश्चतुर्भ्यो ग्राह्या बन्धेभ्यः परि पात्वस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
akshvaikam manimekam krinushva snahyekena pibaikamesham |
chaturviram nairritebhyashchaturbhyo grahya bandhebhyah pari patvasman ||

verses.sa:
अग्निर्माग्निनावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे वर्चस ओजसे ।
तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
agnirmagninavatu pranayapanayayushe varchasa ojase |
tejase svastaye subhutaye svaha ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मेन्द्रियेणावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे वर्चस ओजसे ।
तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
indro mendriyenavatu pranayapanayayushe varchasa ojase |
tejase svastaye subhutaye svaha ||

verses.sa:
सोमो मा सौम्येनावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे वर्चस ओजसे ।
तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
somo ma saumyenavatu pranayapanayayushe varchasa ojase |
tejase svastaye subhutaye svaha ||

verses.sa:
भगो मा भगेनावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे वर्चस ओजसे ।
तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
bhago ma bhagenavatu pranayapanayayushe varchasa ojase |
tejase svastaye subhutaye svaha ||

verses.sa:
मरुतो मा गणैरवन्तु प्राणायापानायुषे वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे ।
स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
maruto ma ganairavantu pranayapanayushe varchasa ojase tejase |
svastaye subhutaye svaha ||

prose.en:
1. Bringing together witchcraft to the house of the witchcraft-maker, as it were debt from debt, do thou, O ointment, crush in the ribs of the hostile eye-conjurer.

2. What evil-dreaming [is] in us, what in [our] kine, and what in our house, also the...of one hostile, let him that is unfriendly take upon himself (prati-muc).

3. Increasing from the force of the refreshment of the waters, born out of Agni Jātavedas—may the ointment that is four-heroed, that is of the mountains, make the quarters, the directions, propitious to thee.

4. The four-heroed ointment is bound to thee; be all the quarters free from fear for thee; firm shalt thou stand, like Savitar desirable; let these people (víças) render thee tribute.

5. Use thou one as ointment; make one an amulet; bathe with one; drink one of them; let the four-heroed one protect us about from the four destructive bonds of seizure (grā́hi).

6. Let Agni favor (av) me with fire (? agní), in order to breath, to expiration, to life-time, to splendor, to force, to brilliancy, to well-being, to welfare: hail!

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिष्ट्वा बध्नात्प्रथममस्तृतं वीर्याय कम् ।
तत्ते बध्नाम्यायुषे वर्चस ओजसे च बलाय चास्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatishtva badhnatprathamamastritam viryaya kam |
tatte badhnamyayushe varchasa ojase cha balaya chastritastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: Prajāpati bound thee first [as] unsubdued (ástṛta), in order to heroism; it do I bind for thee in order to life-time, to splendor, and to force and to strength: let the unsubdued one defend thee.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठतु रक्षन्न् अप्रमादमस्तृतेमं मा त्वा दभन् पणयो यातुधानाः ।
इन्द्र इव दस्यून् अव धूनुष्व पृतन्यतः सर्वां छत्रून् वि षहस्वास्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvastishthatu rakshann apramadamastritemam ma tva dabhan panayo yatudhanah |
indra iva dasyun ava dhunushva pritanyatah sarvam chhatrun vi shahasvastritastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: Standing upright, defend thou this man unremittingly, O unsubdued one; let not the Paṇis, the sorcerers, damage thee; as Indra the barbarians, [so] do thou shake down them that fight [us]; overpower and scatter (ví) all our rivals: let the unsubdued one defend thee.

verses.sa:
शतं च न प्रहरन्तो निघ्नन्तो न तस्तिरे ।
तस्मिन्न् इन्द्रः पर्यदत्त चक्षुः प्राणमथो बलमस्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
shatam cha na praharanto nighnanto na tastire |
tasminn indrah paryadatta chakshuh pranamatho balamastritastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: Whom even a hundred, hurling (pra-hṛ), smiting down, have not subdued (stṛ), to him Indra committed sight, breath, also strength: let the unsubdued one defend thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य त्वा वर्मणा परि धापयामो यो देवानामधिराजो बभूव ।
पुनस्त्वा देवाः प्र णयन्तु सर्वेऽस्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya tva varmana pari dhapayamo yo devanamadhirajo babhuva |
punastva devah pra nayantu sarve'stritastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: With Indra's defense (várman) we surround thee, who became over-king of the gods; let all the gods lead thee forward again; let the unsubdued one defend thee.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन् मणावेकशतं वीर्याणि सहस्रं प्राणा अस्मिन्न् अस्तृते ।
व्याघ्रः शत्रून् अभि तिष्ठ सर्वान् यस्त्वा पृतन्यादधरः सो अस्त्वस्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
asmin manavekashatam viryani sahasram prana asminn astrite |
vyaghrah shatrun abhi tishtha sarvan yastva pritanyadadharah so astvastritastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: In this amulet [are] a hundred and one heroisms; a thousand breaths in this unsubdued one; a tiger, do thou attack (abhi-sthā) all [our] rivals; whoso shall fight against thee, be he inferior (ádhara): let the unsubdued one defend thee.

verses.sa:
घृतादुल्लुप्तो मधुमान् पयस्वान्त्सहस्रप्राणः शतयोनिर्वयोधाः ।
शम्भूश्च मयोभूश्चोर्जस्वांश्च पयस्वांश्चास्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
ghritadullupto madhuman payasvantsahasrapranah shatayonirvayodhah |
shambhushcha mayobhushchorjasvamshcha payasvamshchastritastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: Snatched out of ghee, rich in honey, rich in milk, thousand-breathed, hundred-wombed (? -yóni), vigor-imparting, both wealful and delightful, both rich in refreshment and rich in milk—let the unsubdued one defend thee.

verses.sa:
यथा त्वमुत्तरोऽसो असपत्नः सपत्नहा ।
सजातानामसद्वशी तथा त्वा सविता करदस्तृतस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
yatha tvamuttaro'so asapatnah sapatnaha |
sajatanamasadvashi tatha tva savita karadastritastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: That thou mayest be superior, free from rivals, rival-slaying—mayest be controler of thy fellows—so may Savitar make thee: let the unsubdued one defend thee.

verses.sa:
आ रात्रि पार्थिवं रजः पितुरप्रायि धामभिः ।
दिवः सदांसि बृहती वि तिष्ठस आ त्वेषं वर्तते तमः ॥
verses.rom:
a ratri parthivam rajah pituraprayi dhamabhih |
divah sadamsi brihati vi tishthasa a tvesham vartate tamah ||

verses.sa:
न यस्याः पारं ददृशे न योयुवद्विश्वमस्यां नि विशते यदेजति ।
अरिष्टासस्त उर्वि तमस्वति रात्रि पारमशीमहि भद्रे पारमशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
na yasyah param dadrishe na yoyuvadvishvamasyam ni vishate yadejati |
arishtasasta urvi tamasvati ratri paramashimahi bhadre paramashimahi ||

verses.sa:
ये ते रात्रि नृचक्षसो द्रष्टारो नवतिर्नव ।
अशीतिः सन्त्यष्टा उतो ते सप्त सप्ततिः ॥
verses.rom:
ye te ratri nrichakshaso drashtaro navatirnava |
ashitih santyashta uto te sapta saptatih ||

verses.sa:
षष्टिश्च षट्च रेवति पञ्चाशत्पञ्च सुम्नयि ।
चत्वारश्चत्वारिंशच्च त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च वाजिनि ॥
verses.rom:
shashtishcha shatcha revati panchashatpancha sumnayi |
chatvarashchatvarimshachcha trayastrimshachcha vajini ||

verses.sa:
द्वौ च ते विंशतिश्च ते रात्र्येकादशावमाः ।
तेभिर्नो अद्य पायुभिर्नु पाहि दुहितर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
dvau cha te vimshatishcha te ratryekadashavamah |
tebhirno adya payubhirnu pahi duhitardivah ||

verses.sa:
रक्षा माकिर्नो अघशंस ईशत मा नो दुःशंस ईशत ।
मा नो अद्य गवां स्तेनो मावीनां वृक ईशत ॥
verses.rom:
raksha makirno aghashamsa ishata ma no duhshamsa ishata |
ma no adya gavam steno mavinam vrika ishata ||

verses.sa:
माश्वानां भद्रे तस्करो मा नृणां यातुधान्यः ।
परमेभिः पथिभि स्तेनो धावतु तस्करः ।
परेण दत्वती रज्जुः परेणाघायुरर्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
mashvanam bhadre taskaro ma nrinam yatudhanyah |
paramebhih pathibhi steno dhavatu taskarah |
parena datvati rajjuh parenaghayurarshatu ||

verses.sa:
अध रात्रि तृष्टधूममशीर्षाणमहिं कृणु ।
हनू वृकस्य जम्भया स्तेनं द्रुपदे जहि ॥
verses.rom:
adha ratri trishtadhumamashirshanamahim krinu |
hanu vrikasya jambhaya stenam drupade jahi ||

verses.sa:
त्वयि रात्रि वसामसि स्वपिष्यामसि जागृहि ।
गोभ्यो नः शर्म यछाश्वेभ्यः पुरुषेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvayi ratri vasamasi svapishyamasi jagrihi |
gobhyo nah sharma yachhashvebhyah purushebhyah ||

prose.en:
1. O night, the earthly space (rájas) hath been filled with the father's orderings (dhā́man); great, thou spreadest thyself (vi-sthā) to the seats of the sky; bright darkness comes on (ā-vṛt).

2. She of whom the further limit is not seen, nor what separates; in her everything that stirs goes to rest (ni-viç); uninjured may we, O wide darksome night, attain thy further limit—may we, O excellent one, attain thy further limit.

3. The men-watching lookers that are thine, O night, ninety [and] nine—eighty are they [and] eight, also seven [and] seventy of thine;—

4. And sixty and six, O wealthy one; fifty [and] five, O pleasant one; four and forty, three and thirty, O mighty (vājín) one;—

5. And two of thine and twenty of thine, O night; eleven the least (avamá)—with those protectors today do thou protect us, O daughter of the sky.

6. Let no demon, [no] mischief-plotter master us; let no evil-plotter master us; let no thief today master our kine, nor a wolf our sheep;—

verses.sa:
अथो यानि च यस्मा ह यानि चान्तः परीणहि ।
तानि ते परि दद्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
atho yani cha yasma ha yani chantah parinahi |
tani te pari dadmasi ||
verses.en: Now then what things we note, or what things are within the box, those things we commit to thee.

verses.sa:
रात्रि मातरुषसे नः परि देहि ।
उषा नो अह्ने परि ददात्वहस्तुभ्यं विभावरि ॥
verses.rom:
ratri matarushase nah pari dehi |
usha no ahne pari dadatvahastubhyam vibhavari ||
verses.en: O night! mother! commit thou us to the dawn; let the dawn commit us to the day, the day to thee, O shining one (vibhādvarī).

verses.sa:
यत्किं चेदं पतयति यत्किं चेदं सरीसृपम् ।
यत्किं च पर्वतायासत्वं तस्मात्त्वं रात्रि पाहि नः ॥
verses.rom:
yatkim chedam patayati yatkim chedam sarisripam |
yatkim cha parvatayasatvam tasmattvam ratri pahi nah ||
verses.en: Whatsoever flies here, whatsoever that is crawling (sarīsṛpá) is here, whatsoever creature is on the mountain—from that do thou, O night, protect us.

verses.sa:
सा पश्चात्पाहि सा पुरः सोत्तरादधरादुत ।
गोपाय नो विभावरि स्तोतारस्त इह स्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
sa pashchatpahi sa purah sottaradadharaduta |
gopaya no vibhavari stotarasta iha smasi ||
verses.en: Do thou protect behind, thou in front, thou from above and from below; do thou guard us, O shining one; here we are, thy praisers.

verses.sa:
ये रात्रिमनुतिष्ठन्ति ये च भूतेषु जाग्रति ।
पशून् ये सर्वान् रक्षन्ति ते न आत्मसु जाग्रति ते नः पशुषु जाग्रति ॥
verses.rom:
ye ratrimanutishthanti ye cha bhuteshu jagrati |
pashun ye sarvan rakshanti te na atmasu jagrati te nah pashushu jagrati ||
verses.en: They who follow (anu-sthā) the night, and who watch over beings, who defend all cattle—they watch over our selves (ātmán), they watch over our cattle.

verses.sa:
वेद वै रात्रि ते नाम घृताची नाम वा असि ।
तां त्वां भरद्वाजो वेद सा नो वित्तेऽधि जाग्रति ॥
verses.rom:
veda vai ratri te nama ghritachi nama va asi |
tam tvam bharadvajo veda sa no vitte'dhi jagrati ||
verses.en: Verily I know thy name, O night; thou art "ghee-dripping" (ghṛtā́cī) by name; as such Bharadvāja knows thee; do thou watch over our property.

verses.sa:
इषिरा योषा युवतिर्दमूना रात्री देवस्य सवितुर्भगस्य ।
अश्वक्षभा सुहवा संभृतश्रीरा पप्रौ द्यावापृथिवी महित्वा ॥
verses.rom:
ishira yosha yuvatirdamuna ratri devasya saviturbhagasya |
ashvakshabha suhava sambhritashrira paprau dyavaprithivi mahitva ||
verses.en: The lively woman, household maiden, night, of god Savitar, of Bhaga, all-expanded, of easy invocation, of assembled fortune (? -çrī́), hath filled heaven-and-earth with greatness.

verses.sa:
अति विश्वान्यरुहद्गम्भिरो वर्षिष्ठमरुहन्त श्रविष्ठाः ।
उशती रात्र्यनु सा भद्राभि तिष्ठते मित्र इव स्वधाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ati vishvanyaruhadgambhiro varshishthamaruhanta shravishthah |
ushati ratryanu sa bhadrabhi tishthate mitra iva svadhabhih ||
verses.en: The profound one hath surmounted all things; the most mighty one hath ascended to the loftiest sky; the eager night spreads toward me like a friend with excellent svadhā́s.

verses.sa:
वर्ये वन्दे सुभगे सुजात आजगन् रात्रि सुमना इह स्याम् ।
अस्मांस्त्रायस्व नर्याणि जाता अथो यानि गव्यानि पुष्ट्या ॥
verses.rom:
varye vande subhage sujata ajagan ratri sumana iha syam |
asmamstrayasva naryani jata atho yani gavyani pushtya ||
verses.en: O desirable, welcome, well-portioned, well-born one! thou didst come, O night; mayest thou be well-willing here; save thou for us the things that are produced (jātá) for men, likewise what [are] for cattle, by prosperity puṣṭyā́.

verses.sa:
सिंहस्य रात्र्युशती पींषस्य व्याघ्रस्य द्वीपिनो वर्च आ ददे ।
अश्वस्य ब्रध्नं पुरुषस्य मायुं पुरु रूपाणि कृणुषे विभाती ॥
verses.rom:
simhasya ratryushati pimshasya vyaghrasya dvipino varcha a dade |
ashvasya bradhnam purushasya mayum puru rupani krinushe vibhati ||
verses.en: The eager night has taken to herself the splendor of the lion, of the stag, of the tiger, of the leopard, the horse's bottom, man's (púruṣa) roar (? māyú); many forms thou makest for thyself, shining out.

verses.sa:
शिवां रात्रिमनुसूर्यं च हिमस्य माता सुहवा नो अस्तु ।
अस्य स्तोमस्य सुभगे नि बोध येन त्वा वन्दे विश्वासु दिक्षु ॥
verses.rom:
shivam ratrimanusuryam cha himasya mata suhava no astu |
asya stomasya subhage ni bodha yena tva vande vishvasu dikshu ||
verses.en: Propitious to me [be] night and [the time] after sunrise; be the mother of cold (himá) easy of invocation for us; notice, O well-portioned one, this song of praise, with which I greet thee in all the quarters.

verses.sa:
स्तोमस्य नो विभावरि रात्रि राजेव जोषसे ।
असाम सर्ववीरा भवाम सर्ववेदसो व्युच्छन्तीरनूषसः ॥
verses.rom:
stomasya no vibhavari ratri rajeva joshase |
asama sarvavira bhavama sarvavedaso vyuchchhantiranushasah ||
verses.en: Our song of praise, O shining (vibhā́van) night, like a king thou enjoyest; may we be having all heroes, may we become having all possessions, through (ánu) the out-shining dawns.

verses.sa:
शम्या ह नाम दधिषे मम दिप्सन्ति ये धना ।
रात्रीहि तान् असुतपा य स्तेनो न विद्यते यत्पुनर्न विद्यते ॥
verses.rom:
shamya ha nama dadhishe mama dipsanti ye dhana |
ratrihi tan asutapa ya steno na vidyate yatpunarna vidyate ||
verses.en: Pleasant names thou assumest:—whoso desire to damage my riches, them, O night, do thou burn continually, so that no thief be found, so that he be not found again.

verses.sa:
भद्रासि रात्रि चमसो न विष्टो विष्वङ्गोरूपं युवतिर्बिभर्षि ।
चक्षुष्मती मे उशती वपूम्षि प्रति त्वं दिव्या न क्षाममुक्थाः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadrasi ratri chamaso na vishto vishvangorupam yuvatirbibharshi |
chakshushmati me ushati vapumshi prati tvam divya na kshamamukthah ||
verses.en: Excellent art thou, O night, like a decorated bowl; thou bearest [as] maiden the whole form of kine; full of eyes, eager, [thou showest] me wondrous forms; thou hast put on (prati-muc) the stars of heaven (divyá).

verses.sa:
यो अद्य स्तेन आयत्यघायुर्मर्त्यो रिपुः ।
रात्री तस्य प्रतीत्य प्र ग्रीवाः प्र शिरो हनत् ॥
verses.rom:
yo adya stena ayatyaghayurmartyo ripuh |
ratri tasya pratitya pra grivah pra shiro hanat ||
verses.en: What thief shall come today, [what] malicious mortal villain, may night, going to meet him, smite away the neck, away the head of him;—

verses.sa:
प्र पादौ न यथायति प्र हस्तौ न यथाशिषत्।
यो मलिम्लुरुपायति स संपिष्टो अपायति ।
अपायति स्वपायति शुष्के स्थाणावपायति ॥
verses.rom:
pra padau na yathayati pra hastau na yathashishat|
yo malimlurupayati sa sampishto apayati |
apayati svapayati shushke sthanavapayati ||
verses.en: Away his feet, that he may not go; away his hands, that he may not harm.

verses.sa:
अध रात्रि तृष्टधूममशीर्षाणमहिं कृणु ।
अक्षौ वृकस्य निर्जह्यास्तेन तं द्रुपदे जहि ॥
verses.rom:
adha ratri trishtadhumamashirshanamahim krinu |
akshau vrikasya nirjahyastena tam drupade jahi ||
verses.en: Do thou, O night, make the snake blind, harsh-smoked, headless; smite out the eyes of the wolf; cast the thief into the snare.

verses.sa:
ये ते रात्र्यनड्वाहस्तीक्ष्णशृङ्गाः स्वाशवः ।
तेभिर्नो अद्य पारयाति दुर्गाणि विश्वहा ॥
verses.rom:
ye te ratryanadvahastikshnashringah svashavah |
tebhirno adya parayati durgani vishvaha ||
verses.en: What draft-oxen thou hast, O night, sharp-horned, very swift, with them do thou today pass us always (viçváhā) over difficulties.

verses.sa:
रात्रिंरात्रिमरिष्यन्तस्तरेम तन्वा वयम् ।
गम्भीरमप्लवा इव न तरेयुररातयः ॥
verses.rom:
ratrimratrimarishyantastarema tanva vayam |
gambhiramaplava iva na tareyuraratayah ||
verses.en: May we pass (tṛ) night after night receiving no harm with ourselves (tanvā̀); may the niggards fail to pass [it], as men without boats a deep [water].

verses.sa:
यथा शाम्याकः प्रपतन्न् अपवान् नानुविद्यते ।
एवा रात्रि प्र पातय यो अस्मामभ्यघायति ॥
verses.rom:
yatha shamyakah prapatann apavan nanuvidyate |
eva ratri pra pataya yo asmamabhyaghayati ||
verses.en: As the millet-seed, flying forth, blowing away, is not found, so, O night, make him fly forth who is malicious against us.

verses.sa:
अप स्तेनं वासयो गोअजमुत तस्करम् ।
अथो यो अर्वतः शिरोऽभिधाय निनीषति ॥
verses.rom:
apa stenam vasayo goajamuta taskaram |
atho yo arvatah shiro'bhidhaya ninishati ||
verses.en: Thou didst make the thief stay away, and the kine-driving robber, also him who, haltering the courser's head, tries to lead it [away].

verses.sa:
यदद्य रात्रि सुभगे विभजन्त्ययो वसु ।
यदेतदस्मान् भोजय यथेदन्यान् उपायसि ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya ratri subhage vibhajantyayo vasu |
yadetadasman bhojaya yathedanyan upayasi ||
verses.en: When, O well-portioned night, thou comest today, sharing out what is good, [then] make us to enjoy that, that it go not away.

verses.sa:
उषसे नः परि देहि सर्वान् रात्र्यनागसः ।
उषा नो अह्ने आ भजादहस्तुभ्यं विभावरि ॥
verses.rom:
ushase nah pari dehi sarvan ratryanagasah |
usha no ahne a bhajadahastubhyam vibhavari ||
verses.en: Unto the dawn, O night, do thou commit us all, free from guilt; may the dawn bestow (ā-bhaj) us on the day, the day on thee, O shining one.

verses.sa:
अयुतोऽहमयुतो म आत्मायुतं मे चक्षुरयुतं मे श्रोत्रम् ।
अयुतो मे प्राणोऽयुतो मेऽपानोऽयुतो मे व्यानोऽयुतोऽहं सर्वः ॥
verses.rom:
ayuto'hamayuto ma atmayutam me chakshurayutam me shrotram |
ayuto me prano'yuto me'pano'yuto me vyano'yuto'ham sarvah ||
verses.en: Unrepelled (? áyuta) am I, unrepelled my soul, unrepelled my sight, unrepelled my hearing, unrepelled my breath, unrepelled my expiration, unrepelled my out-breathing, unrepelled the whole of me.

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रसूत आ रभे ॥
verses.rom: devasya tva savituh prasave'shvinorbahubhyam pushno hastabhyam prasuta a rabhe ||
verses.en: In the impulse of the heavenly impeller (savitṛ́), with the arms of the Açvins, with the hands of Pūshan, I, impelled, take hold of thee.

verses.sa:
कामस्तदग्रे समवर्तत मनसो रेतः प्रथमं यदासीत्।
स काम कामेन बृहता सयोनी रायस्पोषं यजमानाय धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
kamastadagre samavartata manaso retah prathamam yadasit|
sa kama kamena brihata sayoni rayasposham yajamanaya dhehi ||
verses.en: Desire here came into being (sam-vṛt) in the beginning, which was the first seed of mind; O desire, being of one origin with great desire, do thou impart abundance of wealth to the sacrificer.

verses.sa:
त्वं काम सहसासि प्रतिष्ठितो विभुर्विभावा सख आ सखीयते ।
त्वमुग्रः पृतनासु ससहिः सह ओजो यजमानाय धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam kama sahasasi pratishthito vibhurvibhava sakha a sakhiyate |
tvamugrah pritanasu sasahih saha ojo yajamanaya dhehi ||
verses.en: Thou, O desire, art set firm with power, mighty, shining (vibhā́van), companion for him who seeks a companion; do thou, formidable, overpowering in fights, impart power [and] force to the sacrificer.

verses.sa:
दूराच्चकमानाय प्रतिपाणायाक्षये ।
आस्मा अशृण्वन्न् आशाः कामेनाजनयन्त्स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
durachchakamanaya pratipanayakshaye |
asma ashrinvann ashah kamenajanayantsvah ||
verses.en: To him that desired from afar, that trembled on at the inexhaustible—the places (ā́çā) listen to him; by desire they generated heaven.

verses.sa:
कामेन मा काम आगन् हृदयाद्धृदयं परि ।
यदमीषामदो मनस्तदैतूप मामिह ॥
verses.rom:
kamena ma kama agan hridayaddhridayam pari |
yadamishamado manastadaitupa mamiha ||
verses.en: By desire hath desire come to me, out of heart to heart; the mind that is theirs yonder, let that come unto me here.

verses.sa:
यत्काम कामयमाना इदं कृण्मसि ते हविः ।
तन् नः सर्वं समृध्यतामथैतस्य हविषो वीहि स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yatkama kamayamana idam krinmasi te havih |
tan nah sarvam samridhyatamathaitasya havisho vihi svaha ||
verses.en: Desiring what, O desire, we make to thee this oblation, let that all succeed with us; then eat (vī) thou of this oblation: hail!

verses.sa:
कालो अश्वो वहति सप्तरश्मिः सहस्राक्षो अजरो भूरिरेताः ।
तमा रोहन्ति कवयो विपश्चितस्तस्य चक्रा भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
kalo ashvo vahati saptarashmih sahasraksho ajaro bhuriretah |
tama rohanti kavayo vipashchitastasya chakra bhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en: Time (kālá) drives (vah) [as] a horse with seven reins, thousand-eyed, unaging, possessing much seed; him the inspired poets mount; his wheels are all beings (bhúvana).

verses.sa:
सप्त चक्रान् वहति काल एष सप्तास्य नाभीरमृतं न्वक्षः ।
स इमा विश्वा भुवनान्यञ्जत्कालः स ईयते प्रथमो नु देवः ॥
verses.rom:
sapta chakran vahati kala esha saptasya nabhiramritam nvakshah |
sa ima vishva bhuvananyanjatkalah sa iyate prathamo nu devah ||
verses.en: Seven wheels doth this time drive; seven [are] his naves, immortality (amṛ́ta) forsooth [his] axle; he, time, including (?) all these beings, goes on as first god.

verses.sa:
पूर्णः कुम्भोऽधि काल आहितस्तं वै पश्यामो बहुधा नु सन्तम् ।
स इमा विश्वा भुवनानि प्रत्यङ्कालं तमाहुः परमे व्योमन् ॥
verses.rom:
purnah kumbho'dhi kala ahitastam vai pashyamo bahudha nu santam |
sa ima vishva bhuvanani pratyankalam tamahuh parame vyoman ||
verses.en: A full vessel is set upon time; we indeed see it, being now manifoldly; it [is] in front of all these beings; it call they time in the highest firmament (vyòman).

verses.sa:
स एव सं भुवनान्याभरत्स एव सं भुवनानि पर्यैत्।
पिता सन्न् अभवत्पुत्र एषां तस्माद्वै नान्यत्परमस्ति तेजः ॥
verses.rom:
sa eva sam bhuvananyabharatsa eva sam bhuvanani paryait|
pita sann abhavatputra esham tasmadvai nanyatparamasti tejah ||
verses.en: He indeed together brought beings; he indeed together went about (pari-i) beings; being father, he became son of them; than him verily there is no other brilliancy that is higher (pára).

verses.sa:
कालोऽमूं दिवमजनयत्काल इमाः पृथिवीरुत ।
काले ह भूतं भव्यं चेषितं ह वि तिष्ठते ॥
verses.rom:
kalo'mum divamajanayatkala imah prithiviruta |
kale ha bhutam bhavyam cheshitam ha vi tishthate ||
verses.en: Time generated yonder sky, time also these earths; what is and what is to be stands out sent forth by time.

verses.sa:
कालो भूतिमसृजत काले तपति सूर्यः ।
काले ह विश्वा भूतानि काले चक्षुर्वि पश्यति ॥
verses.rom:
kalo bhutimasrijata kale tapati suryah |
kale ha vishva bhutani kale chakshurvi pashyati ||
verses.en: Time created the earth; in time burns (tap) the sun; in time [are] all existences; in time the eye looks abroad.

verses.sa:
काले मनः काले प्राणः काले नाम समाहितम् ।
कालेन सर्वा नन्दन्त्यागतेन प्रजा इमाः ॥
verses.rom:
kale manah kale pranah kale nama samahitam |
kalena sarva nandantyagatena praja imah ||
verses.en: In time is mind, in time is breath, in time is name collected (sam-ā-dhā); by time, when arrived, all these creatures (prajā́) are glad (nand).

verses.sa:
काले तपः काले ज्येष्ठं काले ब्रह्म समाहितम् ।
कालो ह सर्वस्येश्वरो यः पितासीत्प्रजापतेः ॥
verses.rom:
kale tapah kale jyeshtham kale brahma samahitam |
kalo ha sarvasyeshvaro yah pitasitprajapateh ||
verses.en: In time is fervor, in time is what is chief, in time is the bráhman collected; time is the lord (īçvará) of all, who was father of Prajāpati.

verses.sa:
तेनेषितं तेन जातं तदु तस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
कालो ह ब्रह्म भूत्वा बिभर्ति परमेष्ठिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
teneshitam tena jatam tadu tasmin pratishthitam |
kalo ha brahma bhutva bibharti parameshthinam ||
verses.en: Sent by it, born by it, in it is this (tát) set firm; time, becoming the bráhman, bears the most exalted one.

verses.sa:
कालः प्रजा असृजत कालो अग्रे प्रजापतिम् ।
स्वयंभूः कश्यपः कालात्तपः कालादजायत ॥
verses.rom:
kalah praja asrijata kalo agre prajapatim |
svayambhuh kashyapah kalattapah kaladajayata ||
verses.en: Time generated progeny, time in the beginning Prajāpati; the self-existent Kaçyapa from time, fervor from time was born.

verses.sa:
कालादापः समभवन् कालाद्ब्रह्म तपो दिशः ।
कालेनोदेति सूर्यः काले नि विशते पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
kaladapah samabhavan kaladbrahma tapo dishah |
kalenodeti suryah kale ni vishate punah ||

verses.sa:
कालेन वातः पवते कालेन पृथिवी मही ।
द्यौर्मही काल आहिता ॥
verses.rom:
kalena vatah pavate kalena prithivi mahi |
dyaurmahi kala ahita ||

verses.sa:
कालो ह भूतं भव्यं च पुत्रो अजनयत्पुरा ।
कालादृचः समभवन् यजुः कालादजायत ॥
verses.rom:
kalo ha bhutam bhavyam cha putro ajanayatpura |
kaladrichah samabhavan yajuh kaladajayata ||

verses.sa:
कालो यज्ञं समैरयद्देवेभ्यो भागमक्षितम् ।
काले गन्धर्वाप्सरसः काले लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥
verses.rom:
kalo yajnam samairayaddevebhyo bhagamakshitam |
kale gandharvapsarasah kale lokah pratishthitah ||

verses.sa:
कालेऽयमङ्गिरा देवोऽथर्वा चाधि तिष्ठतः ।
इमं च लोकं परमं च लोकं पुण्यांश्च लोकान् विधृतीश्च पुण्याः ।
सर्वांल्लोकान् अभिजित्य ब्रह्मणा कालः स ईयते परमो नु देवः ॥
verses.rom:
kale'yamangira devo'tharva chadhi tishthatah |
imam cha lokam paramam cha lokam punyamshcha lokan vidhritishcha punyah |
sarvamllokan abhijitya brahmana kalah sa iyate paramo nu devah ||

prose.en:
1. From time came into being the waters; from time [came] the bráhman, fervor, the quarters; by time the sun rises; in time he goes to rest (ni-viç) again.

2. Comm's 2 a, b, c. By time the wind cleanses (pavate); by time the earth [is] great; the great sky in time [is] set.

3. Comm's 2 d, e. Time, [their] son, generated of old what is and what is to be. Comm's 3 a, b. From time the verses (ṛ́c) came into being; the sacrificial formula (yájus) was born from time;—

4. Comm's 3 c, d. Time set in motion (sam-īr) the sacrifice, an unexhausted portion for the gods. Comm's 4 a, b. In time are set firm the Gandharvas-and-Apsarases; in time the worlds;—

verses.sa:
रात्रिंरात्रिमप्रयातं भरन्तोऽश्वायेव तिष्ठते घासमस्मै ।
रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदन्तो मा ते अग्ने प्रतिवेशा रिषाम ॥
verses.rom:
ratrimratrimaprayatam bharanto'shvayeva tishthate ghasamasmai |
rayasposhena samisha madanto ma te agne prativesha rishama ||

verses.sa:
या ते वसोर्वात इषुः सा त एषा तया नो मृड ।
रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदन्तो मा ते अग्ने प्रतिवेशा रिषाम ॥
verses.rom:
ya te vasorvata ishuh sa ta esha taya no mrida |
rayasposhena samisha madanto ma te agne prativesha rishama ||

verses.sa:
सायंसायं गृहपतिर्नो अग्निः प्रातःप्रातः सौमनसस्य दाता ।
वसोर्वसोर्वसुदान एधि वयं त्वेन्धानास्तन्वं पुषेम ॥
verses.rom:
sayamsayam grihapatirno agnih pratahpratah saumanasasya data |
vasorvasorvasudana edhi vayam tvendhanastanvam pushema ||

verses.sa:
प्रातःप्रातर्गृहपतिर्नो अग्निः सायंसायं सौमनसस्य दाता ।
वसोर्वसोर्वसुदान एधीन्धानास्त्वा शतंहिमा ऋधेम ॥
verses.rom:
pratahpratargrihapatirno agnih sayamsayam saumanasasya data |
vasorvasorvasudana edhindhanastva shatamhima ridhema ||

verses.sa:
अपश्चा दग्धान्नस्य भूयासम् ।
अन्नादायान्नपतये रुद्राय नमो अग्नये ।
सभ्यः सभां मे पाहि ये च सभ्याः सभासदः ॥
verses.rom:
apashcha dagdhannasya bhuyasam |
annadayannapataye rudraya namo agnaye |
sabhyah sabham me pahi ye cha sabhyah sabhasadah ||

verses.sa:
त्वामिन्द्रा पुरुहूत विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नवन् ।
अहरहर्बलिमित्ते हरन्तोऽश्वायेव तिष्ठते घासमग्ने ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra puruhuta vishvamayurvyashnavan |
aharaharbalimitte haranto'shvayeva tishthate ghasamagne ||

prose.en:
1. Night after night bringing to him without mixture, as fodder to a horse that stands, let not us, O Agni, thy neighbors, receive harm, reveling with abundance of wealth, with food (íṣ).

2. Of thee that art good what arrow [is] in the wind, this is that of thine; therewith be gracious to us. Let not us, O Agni, thy neighbors, receive harm, reveling with abundance of wealth, with food.

3. Evening after evening [is] Agni our house-lord; morning after morning [is he] giver of well-willing; be thou giver of good to us of every kind; may we, kindling thee, adorn (puṣ) ourselves.

4. Morning after morning [is] Agni our house-lord; evening after evening [is he] giver of well-willing; be thou giver of good to us of every kind; kindling thee, may we thrive (ṛdh) a hundred winters.

5. May I be one not falling short of food; to the food-eating lord of food, to Agni [as] Rudra be homage.

6. O thou of the assembly, protect my assembly (sabhā́), and [them] who are of the assembly, sitters in the assembly; having much invoked thee, O Indra, may they attain their whole life-time.

7. Day after day taking tribute to thee, O Agni, as fodder to a horse that stands [, let not us, O Agni, thy neighbors, receive harm, reveling with abundance of wealth, with food (íṣ)].

verses.sa:
यमस्य लोकादध्या बभूविथ प्रमदा मर्त्यान् प्र युनक्षि धीरः ।
एकाकिना सरथं यासि विद्वान्त्स्वप्नं मिमानो असुरस्य योनौ ॥
verses.rom:
yamasya lokadadhya babhuvitha pramada martyan pra yunakshi dhirah |
ekakina saratham yasi vidvantsvapnam mimano asurasya yonau ||
verses.en: Out of Yama's world hast thou come hither (ā-bhū); with mirth (?) dost thou, wise, make use of (pra-yuj) mortals; knowing, thou goest in alliance (sarátham) with the solitary one, fashioning (mā) sleep in the lair (yóni) of the Asura.

verses.sa:
बन्धस्त्वाग्रे विश्वचया अपश्यत्पुरा रात्र्या जनितोरेके अह्नि ।
ततः स्वप्नेदमध्या बभूविथ भिषग्भ्यो रूपमपगूहमानः ॥
verses.rom:
bandhastvagre vishvachaya apashyatpura ratrya janitoreke ahni |
tatah svapnedamadhya babhuvitha bhishagbhyo rupamapaguhamanah ||
verses.en: The all-vigorous bond saw thee in the beginning, in the one day before the birth of night; from thence, O sleep, didst thou come (ā-bhū) hither, hiding thy form from the physicians.

verses.sa:
बृहद्गावासुरेभ्योऽधि देवान् उपावर्तत महिमानमिच्छन् ।
तस्मै स्वप्नाय दधुराधिपत्यं त्रयस्त्रिंशासः स्वरानशानाः ॥
verses.rom:
brihadgavasurebhyo'dhi devan upavartata mahimanamichchhan |
tasmai svapnaya dadhuradhipatyam trayastrimshasah svaranashanah ||
verses.en: He of great kine (?) turned unto the gods away from the Asuras, seeking greatness; to that sleep the three-and-thirty ones, having attained the sky, imparted over-lordship.

verses.sa:
नैतां विदुः पितरो नोत देवा येषां जल्पिश्चरत्यन्तरेदम् ।
त्रिते स्वप्नमदधुराप्त्ये नर आदित्यासो वरुणेनानुशिष्टाः ॥
verses.rom:
naitam viduh pitaro nota deva yesham jalpishcharatyantaredam |
trite svapnamadadhuraptye nara adityaso varunenanushishtah ||
verses.en: Not the Fathers, and not the gods, know it, whose (pl.) murmur goes about within here; in Trita Āptya did the men (nṛ́), the Ādityas, taught by Varuṇa, set sleep.

verses.sa:
यस्य क्रूरमभजन्त दुष्कृतोऽस्वप्नेन सुकृतः पुण्यमायुः ।
स्वर्मदसि परमेण बन्धुना तप्यमानस्य मनसोऽधि जज्ञिषे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya kruramabhajanta dushkrito'svapnena sukritah punyamayuh |
svarmadasi paramena bandhuna tapyamanasya manaso'dhi jajnishe ||
verses.en: Of whom the evil-doers shared bhaj the cruelty, the well-doers, by non-sleep, [shared] the pure (púṇya) life-time—thou revelest in the sky (svàr) with the highest relative; thou wast born out of the mind of one practising fervor.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते सर्वाः परिजाः पुरस्ताद्विद्म स्वप्न यो अधिपा इहा ते ।
यशश्विनो नो यशसेह पाह्याराद्द्विषेभिरप याहि दूरम् ॥
verses.rom:
vidma te sarvah parijah purastadvidma svapna yo adhipa iha te |
yashashvino no yashaseha pahyaraddvishebhirapa yahi duram ||
verses.en: We know all thine attendants (?) in front; we know, O sleep, who is thine over-ruler here; protect us here with the glory of the glorious one; go thou away far off with poisons.

verses.sa:
यथा कलां यथा शफं यथा र्णं सन्नयन्ति ।
एवा दुष्वप्न्यं सर्वमप्रिये सं नयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yatha kalam yatha shapham yatha rnam sannayanti |
eva dushvapnyam sarvamapriye sam nayamasi ||

verses.sa:
सं राजानो अगुः समृणाम्यगुः सं कुष्ठा अगुः सं कला अगुः ।
समस्मासु यद्दुष्वप्न्यं निर्द्विषते दुष्वप्न्यं सुवाम ॥
verses.rom:
sam rajano aguh samrinamyaguh sam kushtha aguh sam kala aguh |
samasmasu yaddushvapnyam nirdvishate dushvapnyam suvama ||

verses.sa:
देवानां पत्नीनां गर्भ यमस्य कर यो भद्रः स्वप्न ।
स मम यः पापस्तद्द्विषते प्र हिण्मः ।
मा तृष्टानामसि कृष्णशकुनेर्मुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
devanam patninam garbha yamasya kara yo bhadrah svapna |
sa mama yah papastaddvishate pra hinmah |
ma trishtanamasi krishnashakunermukham ||

verses.sa:
तं त्वा स्वप्न तथा सं विद्म स त्वं स्वप्नाश्व इव कायमश्व इव नीनाहम् ।
अनास्माकं देवपीयुं पियारुं वप यदस्मासु दुष्वप्न्यं यद्गोषु यच्च नो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva svapna tatha sam vidma sa tvam svapnashva iva kayamashva iva ninaham |
anasmakam devapiyum piyarum vapa yadasmasu dushvapnyam yadgoshu yachcha no grihe ||

verses.sa:
अनास्माकस्तद्देवपीयुः पियारुर्निष्कमिव प्रति मुञ्चताम् ।
नवारत्नीन् अपमया अस्माकं ततः परि ।
दुष्वप्न्यं सर्वं द्विषते निर्दयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
anasmakastaddevapiyuh piyarurnishkamiva prati munchatam |
navaratnin apamaya asmakam tatah pari |
dushvapnyam sarvam dvishate nirdayamasi ||

prose.en:
1. As a sixteenth, as an eighth, as a [whole] debt they bring together, so do we bring together all evil-dreaming on one who is offensive (ápriya).

2. Kings have gathered (sam-gā), debts have gathered, kuṣṭhás have gathered, sixteenths have gathered; all evil-dreaming that is in us—let us impel away evil-dreaming to him that hates us.

3. Embryo of the wives of the gods, instrument of Yama, excellent dream; the evil [dream] that is mine, that do we send forth to him that hates us.

4. Thee that art "harsh" by name, mouth of the black bird (-çakúni)—thee, O sleep, we thus know completely; do thou, O sleep, as a horse a halter, as a horse a girth, scatter him who is not of us, the god-reviler, the mocker.

5. What evil-dreaming is in us, what in our kine, and what in our house, that let him who is not of us, the god-reviler, the mocker, put on like a necklace (niṣká).

6. Having measured off nine cubits, forth from that do we divide off to him who hates us all our evil-dreaming.

verses.sa:
घृतस्य जूतिः समना सदेवा संवत्सरं हविषा वर्धयन्ती ।
श्रोत्रं चक्षुः प्राणोऽछिन्नो नो अस्त्वछिन्ना वयमायुषो वर्चसः ॥
verses.rom:
ghritasya jutih samana sadeva samvatsaram havisha vardhayanti |
shrotram chakshuh prano'chhinno no astvachhinna vayamayusho varchasah ||
verses.en: The swiftness of ghee evenly always increasing the year with oblation—be our hearing, sight, breath unsevered; unsevered be we from life-time, from splendor.

verses.sa:
उपास्मान् प्राणो ह्वयतामुप प्राणं हवामहे ।
वर्चो जग्राह पृथिव्यन्तरिक्षं वर्चः सोमो बृहस्पतिर्विधत्ता ॥
verses.rom:
upasman prano hvayatamupa pranam havamahe |
varcho jagraha prithivyantariksham varchah somo brihaspatirvidhatta ||
verses.en: Let breath call unto us; we call unto breath; the earth, the atmosphere hath seized (grah) splendor; splendor [also] Soma, Bṛihaspati, the maintainer.

verses.sa:
वर्चसो द्यावापृथिवी संग्रहणी बभूवथुर्वर्चो गृहीत्वा पृथिवीमनु सं चरेम ।
यशसं गावो गोपतिमुप तिष्ठन्त्यायतीर्यशो गृहीत्वा पृथिवीमनु सं चरेम ॥
verses.rom:
varchaso dyavaprithivi samgrahani babhuvathurvarcho grihitva prithivimanu sam charema |
yashasam gavo gopatimupa tishthantyayatiryasho grihitva prithivimanu sam charema ||
verses.en: Heaven-and-earth have become joint-seizers of splendor; seizing splendor may we go about upon the earth; with glory the kine, coming, wait upon (upa-sthā) the lord of kine; seizing glory may we go about upon the earth.

verses.sa:
व्रजं कृणुध्वं स हि वो नृपाणो वर्मा सीव्यध्वं बहुला पृथूनि ।
पुरः कृणुध्वमायसीरधृष्टा मा वः सुस्रोच्चमसो दृंहत तम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrajam krinudhvam sa hi vo nripano varma sivyadhvam bahula prithuni |
purah krinudhvamayasiradhrishta ma vah susrochchamaso drimhata tam ||
verses.en: Make ye a pen (vrajá), for that is men-protecting for you; sew ye coats-of-mail (várman), abundant, broad; make ye strongholds of metal, unattackable (ádhṛṣṭā); let not your bowl leak (sru); make it strong.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य चक्षुः प्रभृतिर्मुखं च वाचा श्रोत्रेण मनसा जुहोमि ।
इमं यज्ञं विततं विश्वकर्मणा देवा यन्तु सुमनस्यमानाः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya chakshuh prabhritirmukham cha vacha shrotrena manasa juhomi |
imam yajnam vitatam vishvakarmana deva yantu sumanasyamanah ||
verses.en: Of the sacrifice the eye, beginning, and face; with voice, with hearing, with mind do I make oblation; to this sacrifice, extended by the all-working one, let the gods come ā-i, with favoring minds.

verses.sa:
ये देवानामृत्विजो ये च यज्ञिया येभ्यो हव्यं क्रियते भागधेयम् ।
इमं यज्ञं सह पत्नीभिरेत्य यावन्तो देवास्तविषा मादयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye devanamritvijo ye cha yajniya yebhyo havyam kriyate bhagadheyam |
imam yajnam saha patnibhiretya yavanto devastavisha madayantam ||
verses.en: They that are priests (ṛtvíj) of the gods, and that are worshipful, for whom the oblation (havyá) is made the portion—coming to this sacrifice together with their spouses, let the gods, as many as they are (yā́vant), revel on the oblation.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा ।
त्वं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vratapa asi deva a martyeshva |
tvam yajneshvidyah ||
verses.en: Thou, O Agni, art protector of vows among gods (?), among mortals; thou art to be praised at the sacrifices.

verses.sa:
यद्वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि विदुषां देवा अविदुष्टरासः ।
अग्निष्टद्विश्वादा पृणातु विद्वान्त्सोमस्य यो ब्राह्मणामाविवेश ॥
verses.rom:
yadvo vayam praminama vratani vidusham deva avidushtarasah |
agnishtadvishvada prinatu vidvantsomasya yo brahmanamavivesha ||
verses.en: If we, O gods, detract from (pra-mī) your [ordained] courses—we that are very unknowing, of you that are knowing—let Agni the all-devouring fill that up, knowing, and the soma that has entered the Brahmans.

verses.sa:
आ देवानामपि पन्थामगन्म यच्छक्नवाम तदनुप्रवोढुम् ।
अग्निर्विद्वान्त्स यजात्स इद्धोता सोऽध्वरान्त्स ऋतून् कल्पयाति ॥
verses.rom:
a devanamapi panthamaganma yachchhaknavama tadanupravodhum |
agnirvidvantsa yajatsa iddhota so'dhvarantsa ritun kalpayati ||
verses.en: We have come unto the road of the gods, to convey (vah) along forward what we may be able; Agni [is] knowing; he shall make offering; he verily is hótar; he shall arrange the sacrifices (adhvará), he the seasons.

verses.sa:
वाङ्म आसन् नसोः प्राणश्चक्षुरक्ष्णोः श्रोत्रं कर्णयोः ।
अपलिताः केशा अशोणा दन्ता बहु बाह्वोर्बलम् ॥
verses.rom:
vanma asan nasoh pranashchakshurakshnoh shrotram karnayoh |
apalitah kesha ashona danta bahu bahvorbalam ||
verses.en: Speech in my mouth, breath in my nostrils, sight in my eyes, hearing in my ears, my hair not gray, my teeth not broken, much strength in my arms.

verses.sa:
ऊर्वोरोजो जङ्घयोर्जवः पादयोः ।
प्रतिष्ठा अरिष्टानि मे सर्वात्मानिभृष्टः ॥
verses.rom:
urvorojo janghayorjavah padayoh |
pratishtha arishtani me sarvatmanibhrishtah ||
verses.en: Force in my thighs, speed in my calves, firm standing in my feet, all things of mine uninjured, myself not down-fallen.

verses.sa:
तनूस्तन्वा मे सहे दतः सर्वमायुरशीय ।
स्योनं मे सीद पुरुः पृणस्व पवमानः स्वर्गे ॥
verses.rom:
tanustanva me sahe datah sarvamayurashiya |
syonam me sida puruh prinasva pavamanah svarge ||
verses.en: A body together with my body. ... May I attain all my life-time. Sit thou on what is pleasant; fill thyself full, cleansing thyself in heaven (svargá).

verses.sa:
प्रियं मा कृणु देवेषु प्रियं राजसु मा कृणु ।
प्रियं सर्वस्य पश्यत उत शूद्र उतार्ये ॥
verses.rom:
priyam ma krinu deveshu priyam rajasu ma krinu |
priyam sarvasya pashyata uta shudra utarye ||
verses.en: Make thou me dear to the gods, make me dear to kings, dear to everything that sees, both to Çūdra and to Āryan.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देवान् यज्ञेन बोधय ।
आयुः प्राणं प्रजां पशून् कीर्तिं यजमानं च वर्धय ॥
verses.rom:
uttishtha brahmanaspate devan yajnena bodhaya |
ayuh pranam prajam pashun kirtim yajamanam cha vardhaya ||
verses.en: Arise, O Brahmaṇaspati; awaken the gods with the sacrifice; increase [his] life-time, breath, progeny, cattle, fame, and the sacrificer [himself].

verses.sa:
अग्ने समिधमाहार्षं बृहते जातवेदसे ।
स मे श्रद्धां च मेधां च जातवेदाः प्र यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
agne samidhamaharsham brihate jatavedase |
sa me shraddham cha medham cha jatavedah pra yachchhatu ||

verses.sa:
इध्मेन त्वा जातवेदः समिधा वर्धयामसि ।
तथा त्वमस्मान् वर्धय प्रजया च धनेन च ॥
verses.rom:
idhmena tva jatavedah samidha vardhayamasi |
tatha tvamasman vardhaya prajaya cha dhanena cha ||

verses.sa:
यदग्ने यानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि ।
सर्वं तदस्तु मे शिवं तज्जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadagne yani kani chida te daruni dadhmasi |
sarvam tadastu me shivam tajjushasva yavishthya ||

verses.sa:
एतास्ते अग्ने समिधस्त्वमिद्धः समिद्भव ।
आयुरस्मासु धेह्यमृतत्वमाचार्याय ॥
verses.rom:
etaste agne samidhastvamiddhah samidbhava |
ayurasmasu dhehyamritatvamacharyaya ||

prose.en: 1. O Agni, I have taken fuel for the great Jātavedas; let that Jātavedas extend to me both faith and wisdom.

verses.sa:
हरिः सुपर्णो दिवमारुहोऽर्चिषा ये त्वा दिप्सन्ति दिवमुत्पतन्तम् ।
अव तां जहि हरसा जातवेदोऽबिभ्यदुग्रोऽर्चिषा दिवमा रोह सूर्य ॥
verses.rom:
harih suparno divamaruho'rchisha ye tva dipsanti divamutpatantam |
ava tam jahi harasa jatavedo'bibhyadugro'rchisha divama roha surya ||
verses.en: A yellow eagle, thou hast ascended unto heaven (dív) with radiance (arcís); whoso (pl.) would injure thee flying up to heaven, them smite thou down with flame (háras), O Jātavedas, unfearing; ascend unto heaven, O sun, formidable, with radiance.

verses.sa:
अयोजाला असुरा मायिनोऽयस्मयैः पाशैरङ्किनो ये चरन्ति ।
तांस्ते रन्धयामि हरसा जातवेदः सहस्रऋष्टिः सपत्नान् प्रमृणन् पाहि वज्रः ॥
verses.rom:
ayojala asura mayino'yasmayaih pashairankino ye charanti |
tamste randhayami harasa jatavedah sahasrarishtih sapatnan pramrinan pahi vajrah ||
verses.en: The trickish Asuras that go about, having metal nets, hooking with fetters of metal, them I make subject to thee with flame, O Jātavedas; go thou, a thousand-barbed thunderbolt, slaughtering our rivals.

verses.sa: पश्येम शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom: pashyema sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: May we see a hundred autumns.

verses.sa: जीवेम शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom: jivema sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: May we live a hundred autumns.

verses.sa: बुध्येम शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom: budhyema sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: May we wake a hundred autumns.

verses.sa: रोहेम शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom: rohema sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: May we ascend (ruh) a hundred autumns.

verses.sa: पूषेम शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom: pushema sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: May we prosper a hundred autumns.

verses.sa: भवेम शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom: bhavema sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: May we be a hundred autumns.

verses.sa: भूषेम शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom: bhushema sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: May we adorn a hundred autumns.

verses.sa: भूयसीः शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom: bhuyasih sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: More autumns than a hundred.

verses.sa:
अव्यसश्च व्यचसश्च बिलं वि ष्यामि मायया ।
ताभ्यामुद्धृत्य वेदमथ कर्माणि कृण्महे ॥
verses.rom:
avyasashcha vyachasashcha bilam vi shyami mayaya |
tabhyamuddhritya vedamatha karmani krinmahe ||
verses.en: Of non-expansion and of expansion do I untie the aperture with magic; by those two having taken up the Veda, we then perform acts.

verses.sa: जीवा स्थ जीव्यासं सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम् ॥
verses.rom: jiva stha jivyasam sarvamayurjivyasam ||
verses.en: Living are ye; may I live; may I live my whole life-time.

verses.sa: उपजीवा स्थोप जीव्यासं सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम् ॥
verses.rom: upajiva sthopa jivyasam sarvamayurjivyasam ||
verses.en: Living on are ye; may I live on; may I live my whole life-time.

verses.sa: संजीवा स्थ सं जीव्यासं सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम् ॥
verses.rom: samjiva stha sam jivyasam sarvamayurjivyasam ||
verses.en: Living together are ye; may I live together; may I live my whole life-time.

verses.sa: जीवला स्थ जीव्यासं सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम् ॥
verses.rom: jivala stha jivyasam sarvamayurjivyasam ||
verses.en: Lively are ye; may I live; may I live my whole life-time.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जीव सूर्य जीव देवा जीवा जीव्यासमहम् ।
सर्वमायुर्जीव्यासम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra jiva surya jiva deva jiva jivyasamaham |
sarvamayurjivyasam ||
verses.en: Live, O Indra; live, O Sūrya; live ye, O gods; may I live; may I live my whole life-time.

verses.sa:
स्तुता मया वरदा वेदमाता प्र चोदयन्तां पावमानी द्विजानाम् ।
आयुः प्राणं प्रजां पशुं कीर्तिं द्रविणं ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ।
मह्यं दत्त्वा व्रजत ब्रह्मलोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
stuta maya varada vedamata pra chodayantam pavamani dvijanam |
ayuh pranam prajam pashum kirtim dravinam brahmavarchasam |
mahyam dattva vrajata brahmalokam ||
verses.en: Praised by me [is] the boon-giving Veda-mother. Let them urge on the soma-hymn of the twice-born. Having given to me life-time, breath, progeny, cattle, fame, property, Vedic splendor, go ye to the brahma-world.

verses.sa:
यस्मात्कोशादुदभराम वेदं तस्मिन्न् अन्तरव दध्म एनम् ।
कृतमिष्टं ब्रह्मणो वीर्येण तेन मा देवास्तपसावतेह ॥
verses.rom:
yasmatkoshadudabharama vedam tasminn antarava dadhma enam |
kritamishtam brahmano viryena tena ma devastapasavateha ||
verses.en: Out of what receptacle we bore up the Veda, within that do we set it down; what is performed [and] sacrificed by the heroic might of the bráhman, with that fervor, O gods, favor ye me here.
